Entries.Title: Spider-Man Unlimited
Entries.Description: After the discovery of Counter-Earth, a very Earth like planet in the same orbit on the oposite side of the sun, John  Jameson is sent on the first manned mission to it. But while covering the launch, Peter sees Venom and Carnage enter the shuttle. He tries to stop them, but fails and ends up taking the blame for the assumed loss of the shuttle and gets a bounty on his head. Then, when a plea for help from a John Jameson on Counter-Earth is recived, Peter sees the only way to clear Spider-Man's name as hijacking a new shuttle and go to Counter-Earth himself...

Episodes.Title: Worlds Apart (1)
Episodes.Description: After the discovery of Counter-Earth, a very Earth like planet in the same orbit on the oposite side of the sun, John  Jameson is sent on the first manned mission to it. But while covering the launch, Peter sees Venom and Carnage enter the shuttle. He tries to stop them, but fails and ends up taking the blame for the assumed loss of the shuttle and gets a bounty on his head. Then, when a plea for help from a John Jameson on Counter-Earth is recived, Peter sees the only way to clear Spider-Man's name as hijacking a new shuttle and go to Counter-Earth himself...

Episodes.Title: Worlds Apart (2)
Episodes.Description: Barely escaping from the knights, Spider-Man hooks up with the human resistance movement and finds John. But the joy is short lived, when it turns out they were being followed...

Episodes.Title: Where Evil Nests
Episodes.Description: Naoko is dragged into the sewers by something green, and Spider-Man finds his first suspect when he bumps into the local version of the Green Goblin.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Choices
Episodes.Description: A resistance member steals a sample of one of Sir Ram's experiments, not knowing that it contains a nuclear charge, triggered to explode shortly after the container is removed from the lab. With a lot of ground to cover, the resistance and the knights are left no choice other to cooperate in order to find him before the city is blown to pieces.

Episodes.Title: Steel Cold Heart
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man rescues a robot from being scrapped, after it starts showing signs of sentience. But the freedom is shortlived, as the knights want him back to find the source of his malfunction.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Hunter!
Episodes.Description: Worried about the increasing morale boost Spider-Man has been giving the humans, Sir Ram contacts feared assassin to take him out.

Episodes.Title: Cry Vulture
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man investigates a gang of beastial abducting humans off the street in ambulances, and runs into a new ally - the Vulture.

Episodes.Title: Ill-Met by Moonlight
Episodes.Description: The resistance asks Spider-Man's help in shutting down a bestial power plant that's releasing radioactive waste into the humans' drinking water.

Episodes.Title: Sustenance
Episodes.Description: With the location of his shuttle, Peter decides it's time to go home. Just the right time too. as the Goblin is determined to help him pack.

Episodes.Title: Matters of the Heart
Episodes.Description: After a run-in with the Knights, Bromley leads Spider-Man straight into the hends of the High Evolutionary.

Episodes.Title: One is the Loneliest Number
Episodes.Description: The beastials use a new weapon on Venom, separating the symbiote from his host, Eddie Brock. But alone, Eddie can't survive, leaving Spidey the choice between watching Eddie die, or recreating one of his worst enemies.

Episodes.Title: Sins of the Fathers
Episodes.Description: While visiting the grave of her parents, Karen is captured by the beastials. Spidey and X-51 go in to rescue her, but much to their surprise, they find her well treated... courtesy of the High Evolutionary.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Unleashed (1)
Episodes.Description: Angered by the constant defeats, the High Evolutionary starts a massive crackdown on the human resistance. He threatens to systematically destroy all human homes unless Spider-Man and the rebels surrender to his forces. Angered by the constant defeats, the High Evolutionary starts a massive crackdown on the human resistance. Entries.Title: Marvel's Spider-Man
Entries.Description: Peter is accepted into Horizon High: a school for geniuses, where his best friend Harry Osborn was just suspended. Peter makes his debut as Spider-Man and must battle the Vulture.

Episodes.Title: Horizon High (1)
Episodes.Description: Peter is accepted into Horizon High: a school for geniuses, where his best friend Harry Osborn was just suspended. Peter makes his debut as Spider-Man and must battle the Vulture.

Episodes.Title: Horizon High (2)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must work to stop the Scorpion from wreaking havoc at the museum.

Episodes.Title: Osborn Academy
Episodes.Description: Norman Osborn creates the Osborn Academy for Geniuses as a way of saving his son, Harry, the embarrassment of being suspended from Horizon High.

Episodes.Title: A Day in the Life
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must stop Black Cat from committing a spree of thefts while still keeping his school obligations.

Episodes.Title: Party Animals
Episodes.Description: Horizon High throws a dance in honor of Harry being exonerated, but Norman asks Harry to stay at the Oz Academy.

Episodes.Title: Sandman
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man meets the powerful, yet uncontrollable Sandman and helps him reunite with his estranged daughter with the help of the Venom symbiote.

Episodes.Title: Symbiotic Relationship
Episodes.Description: When Spider-Man uses his new black costume, he discovers that there is great danger in his new power; and he must find a way to defeat a costume that wants to destroy him.

Episodes.Title: Stark Expo
Episodes.Description: After the terror of the symbiote, Spidey is off to the Stark Expo in his old costume. When Ghost hijacks the event, Spidey's only chance to save lives is to unleash the symbiote.

Episodes.Title: Ultimate Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: When Miles Morales is bitten by an experimental spider and gains spider powers, Spider-Man must teach him the responsibilities of being a superhero.

Episodes.Title: Kraven's Amazing Hunt
Episodes.Description: Kraven the Hunter does a live broadcast of his hunt for Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Halloween Moon
Episodes.Description: On Halloween night, Spider-Man must team up with the incredible Hulk to stop Man-Wolf, a super-strong gamma-powered werewolf, from infecting the rest of Manhattan.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Man on Ice
Episodes.Description: Spidey must stop a low-level villain who has acquired some impressive freezing technology.

Episodes.Title: Venom
Episodes.Description: The symbiote has escaped the Avengers Compound and attached itself to a new host. Now Spidey must find out how to beat it and who the new person is underneath.

Episodes.Title: Screwball Live
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is targeted by a new costumed figure named Screwball for a series of online prank videos which block him from fighting crime.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Doc Ock (1)
Episodes.Description: When Otto Octavius is caught in an explosion that fuses his robot arms to his body, Spider-Man sees the opportunity to recruit "The Octopus" into becoming a hero.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Doc Ock (2)
Episodes.Description: Spidey invites The Octopus to patrol the streets alongside Miles and himself until it becomes clear that Otto isn't exactly a team player.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Doc Ock (3)
Episodes.Description: Peter spends a day at Osborn Academy in the hopes of finding a clue that will convince Harry that his father is out to destroy Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Doc Ock (4)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must team up with Gwen Stacy and a reluctant Harry Osborn to investigate the truth behind the missing Raymond Warren aka the Jackal.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man tracks a new villain with spider powers who steals his experimental stealth suit and threatens the entire city.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (2)
Episodes.Description: Everyone in Manhattan manifests spider powers; Spider-Man and Spider-Gwen must help Black Widow track down Crossbones before he delivers the vibranium to Arnim Zola and Hydra.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (3)
Episodes.Description: Peter must find a way to cure Gwen Stacy and Norman Osborn after they turn into spider monsters; things get harder when Kraven the Hunter turns New York into his hunting grounds.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (4)
Episodes.Description: Peter and Harry must battle through an island of spider monsters to get to Norman Osborn, who appears to control them all; the boys discover the real mastermind.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (5)
Episodes.Description: To cure the spider-monster population of Manhattan, Spider-Man must lead Kid Arachnid, Anya and Harry on a desperate, last-ditch effort to stop the Jackal.

Episodes.Title: The Hobgoblin (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man takes on Doc Ock and his Sinister Five before they brainwash Spidey and destroy New York City.

Episodes.Title: The Hobgoblin (2)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must find a way to stop Hobgoblin, who seems completely bent on doing whatever it takes to destroy Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: How I Thwipped My Summer Vacation
Episodes.Description: Peter Parker struggles to balance the best summer vacation ever and his responsibilities as Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Take Two
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is excited to start his second year as a superhero and as a student at Horizon High, but discovers that Doc Ock also claims to want a second chance.

Episodes.Title: Between an Ock and a Hard Place
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man discovers there is a new Doctor Octopus taking up the mantle from Otto Octavius and finds himself drawn into this new mystery, missing the danger right under his nose.

Episodes.Title: Rise Above It All
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man has to infiltrate the viral superstars known as the Wake Riders in order to figure out what the end game is with their stolen Vulture tech. But things take a dangerous turn as Adrian Toomes is tempted back to the dark side.

Episodes.Title: School of Hard Knocks
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man teams up with Ms. Marvel to investigate an elite boarding school after its students start displaying out-of-control, super-powered behaviors.

Episodes.Title: Dead Man’s Party
Episodes.Description: Eddie Brock, who has emerged with the vengeance-filled Venom symbiote, sets his sights on destroying Peter Parker and everything that is Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Venom Returns
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is two steps behind as Venom kidnaps key figures in Peter Parker's life; demanding a face-off against Peter, Venom holds them hostage at Horizon High.

Episodes.Title: Bring on the Bad Guys (1)
Episodes.Description: A mystery villain puts a bounty on Spider-Man's head, bringing on attacks from Panda-Mania, Hippo and Overdrive.

Episodes.Title: Bring on the Bad Guys (2)
Episodes.Description: Anya must step up and embrace being the Spider-Girl; Spider-Man is lured into Mysterio's funhouse and learns that there is a bounty on his head.

Episodes.Title: Bring on the Bad Guys (3)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man faces off against his most bizarre bad guy yet, Jack O'Lantern; he turns Prowler, a reluctant villain, to the side of heroes when he helps him save his brother.

Episodes.Title: Bring on the Bad Guys (4)
Episodes.Description: Spidey tracks the identity of the mysterious boss that put a price on his head and who has been sending villains after him.

Episodes.Title: Brain Drain
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Miles Morales discover Doc Ock, whose mind has been hiding inside the metal body of the Living Brain, has been behind the mysterious bounty for Spider-Man’s head.

Episodes.Title: The Living Brain
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must fight his way through the Super-Villain Holding Facility to challenge the Living Brain, the robot body that houses the mind of Doctor Octopus.

Episodes.Title: The Day Without Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: The Bloodgem accidentally reawakens Gwen Stacy's dormant spider-powers, turning her into Ghost Spider!

Episodes.Title: My Own Worst Enemy
Episodes.Description: Doc Ock intends to bring New York to its knees, but his new brain still contains memories of Uncle Ben.

Episodes.Title: Critical Update
Episodes.Description: Doc Ock must adjust to his new life as a hero and is tested by rising crime boss Sand Girl.

Episodes.Title: A Troubled Mind
Episodes.Description: Superior Spider-Man is confronted by the Avengers who suspect that he is not who he claims to be.

Episodes.Title: Cloak and Dagger
Episodes.Description: When Cloak and Dagger emerge to take revenge against Tiberius Stone and his company, Alchemax, Superior Spider-Man must take them down to protect the school.

Episodes.Title: Superior
Episodes.Description: Superior Spider-Man must face his most challenging opponent when Venom escapes from stasis and attacks Midtown High seeking revenge on Peter Parker.

Episodes.Title: Brand New Day
Episodes.Description: A series of attacks captures the Avengers one-by-one. Spider-Man is left to figure out who is behind the kidnappings.

Episodes.Title: The Cellar
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man takes his mission to The Cellar, where he believes The Regent is using his powers of Cloak & Dagger as well as other supervillains to hold the Avengers captive.

Episodes.Title: The Road to Goblin War
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man has to take down the slick new villain, Slyde, who is stealing various chemicals from around the city in an effort to create a deadly virus that could wipe out New York.

Episodes.Title: Goblin War (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must team up with Spider-Girl Ghost Spider, and Doc Ock to track down a new threat — the mysterious Goblin Nation.

Episodes.Title: Goblin War (2)
Episodes.Description: As Spider-Man and Harry Osborn seek the Goblin King to determine who is behind the Goblin Mask, Spider-Man becomes concerned Harry is leading him into trap.

Episodes.Title: Goblin War (3)
Episodes.Description: Peter Parker struggles with the duality of his social life at school and hiding his secret identity from everyone, including his best friend Harry Osborn

Episodes.Title: Goblin War (4)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man, Miles Morales, Spider-Girl, Ghost Spider, Harry Osborn and Doc Ock must stop the Goblin King in his newly acquired Goblin Mech Suit before he destroys New York City.

Episodes.Title: Web of Venom
Episodes.Description: When Spider-Man and Max Modell experiment on a sample of Venom symbiote, it escapes and unleashes a weapon of unknown purpose.

Episodes.Title: Amazing Friends
Episodes.Description: When Toddler Groot lands on Earth to deliver an urgent warning, Spider-Man must decode the message and keep him out of the evil clutches of both A.I.M. and Baron Mordo.

Episodes.Title: Vengeance of Venom
Episodes.Description: Symbiotes from space send an advanced hunting party to Earth to take out all of the superheroes; Spider-Man must team up with Marc Spector and Max Modell to save the planet.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Man Unmasked
Episodes.Description: After Aleksei is turned back into the rampaging Rhino by Swarm, the Spider Team must battle for their lives in the Underground Monster League contest.

Episodes.Title: Generations
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man discovers Norman Osborn is responsible for the Venom Symbiote's escape; Norman, aka the Dark Goblin, brings the Generations team to battle against Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Maximum Venom
Episodes.Description: When Spider-Man and his allies attempt to track down the missing and dangerous Lizard, they discover that Venom has returned to seek revenge on the earth.

Episodes.Description: A firefly tries to take Magenta on a journey.

Episodes.Description: Big Brown trains Red and Yellow to be better parents.

Episodes.Description: A smartphone causes a ruckus on the rooftop garden.

Episodes.Description: The larvae hold a trial to find out who stole the sausage.

Episodes.Description: A ping pong tournament brings out Red and Yellow's competitive side.

Episodes.Description: When an evil rat brainwashes its friends, Magenta and the others fight back!

Episodes.Description: Will a mega robot be enough to defeat the supersized rodent?

Episodes.Description: Magenta is changing, but her parents aren't sure they're ready.

Episodes.Description: Could this hairy creature be their new little girl?

Episodes.Description: Grandma Bee tries to play matchmaker.

Episodes.Description: Mocha wants to take Magenta on a date.

Episodes.Description: Magenta tries to spread some holiday cheer with her loved ones.

Episodes.Description: The larvae and their pals battle with the wasps to save the rooftop garden.

Entries.Title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
Entries.Description: While being pursued by the Enforcers, Spider-Man has to protect Norman Osborn from the vengeful supervillain Vulture.

Episodes.Title: Survival of the Fittest
Episodes.Description: While being pursued by the Enforcers, Spider-Man has to protect Norman Osborn from the vengeful supervillain Vulture.

Episodes.Title: Interactions
Episodes.Description: When a lab accident transforms Max Dillon into supervillain Electro, he demands that Dr. Martha Connors find a cure as Spider-Man works to stop him.

Episodes.Title: Natural Selection
Episodes.Description: When. Dr. Curt Connors' attempt to regenerate a new arm accidentally transforms him into the Lizard, Peter, Martha, Eddie and Gwen search for a cure.

Episodes.Title: Market Forces
Episodes.Description: Following orders from Kingpin, Hammerhead hires Montana to steal a high-tech suit and, as the Shocker, destroy Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Competition
Episodes.Description: As Peter Parker and Harry Osborn try out for the football team, Spider-Man must face convict Flint Marko, newly transformed into the Sandman in order to destroy Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: The Invisible Hand
Episodes.Description: As Otto creates the Rhino as a new distraction for Spider-Man, Peter takes Aunt May's advice and asks Mary Jane Watson to the high school prom.

Episodes.Title: Catalysts
Episodes.Description: Peter and Mary Jane are a hit at the Fall Formal. Meanwhile, the Green Goblin's attack on Fisk Industries requires Spider-Man's intervention.

Episodes.Title: Reaction
Episodes.Description: When the Green Goblin fuses Otto's robotic arms to his body, the newly created Doctor Octopus must find a new power source as Spider-Man pursues him.

Episodes.Title: The Uncertainty Principle
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man faces off against the Green Goblin and Tombstone. Elsewhere, Col. John Jameson attempts to land a damaged space shuttle.

Episodes.Title: Persona
Episodes.Description: Disguised as Spider-Man, the Chameleon embarks on a crime spree that can only be stopped by Spidey and the Black Cat -- together.

Episodes.Title: Group Therapy
Episodes.Description: When the Sinister Six escape from prison with plans to take down Spider-Man, they nearly succeed. But Peter wakes up with no memory of the battle.

Episodes.Title: Intervention
Episodes.Description: As he struggles with the alien symbiote, Spider-Man's origins are revealed.

Episodes.Title: Nature vs. Nurture
Episodes.Description: Venom -- the merged entity consisting of Eddie Brock and the symbiote -- attacks Spider-Man through the people he loves most.

Episodes.Title: Blueprints
Episodes.Description: Peter's "to do" list includes talking to Gwen Stacy about their first kiss. But before he gets a chance, Spider-Man has a run-in with Mysterio.

Episodes.Title: Destructive Testing
Episodes.Description: Both Liz Allan and Gwen like Peter. Whom should he pursue? Meanwhile, Kraven the Hunter has come to New York City to make Spider-Man his prey.

Episodes.Title: Reinforcement
Episodes.Description: As Christmas approaches, the Sinister Six reconstitutes with Sandman, Rhino, Vulture, Electro and new members Mysterio and Kraven.

Episodes.Title: Shear Strength
Episodes.Description: With the Master Planner and his henchmen planning to take over the world, a highly motivated Spider-Man takes the fight to the Planner's secret lair.

Episodes.Title: First Steps
Episodes.Description: Amazingly, Peter is invited to Flash Thompson's birthday bash. Meanwhile, Spider-Man has to party with Sandman, who's looking to make his big score.

Episodes.Title: Growing Pains
Episodes.Description: After alien spores infect John Jameson -- increasing his size, strength and mass -- his dad persuades him to become a superhero to capture Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Identity Crisis
Episodes.Description: Peter and his loved ones become vulnerable to all of Spider-Man's enemies when Venom exposes Peter's secret identity.

Episodes.Title: Accomplices
Episodes.Description: A gang war looms as Silver Sable, Hammerhead and Doctor Octopus vie for a prize that could change the balance of power in New York City's underworld.

Episodes.Title: Probable Cause
Episodes.Description: Some days, Peter just can't win -- especially when he ends up on a Midtown High police car ride... and as Spider-Man, he isn't faring any better.

Episodes.Title: Gangland
Episodes.Description: On Valentine's Day, Tombstone, Doctor Octopus and Silvermane call a summit that erupts into a gang war -- one that only Spider-Man can stop.

Episodes.Title: Subtext
Episodes.Description: When the Green Goblin blackmails Liz's brother Mark into doing his bidding, neither Liz, Mary Jane nor Spider-Man may be able to save him.

Episodes.Title: Opening Night
Episodes.Description: To test a new Ryker's security cell, Spider-Man volunteers to try to escape. But the Green Goblin traps him inside amid a sea of felons he put away.

Episodes.Title: Final Curtain
Episodes.Description: When Peter breaks up with Liz to be with Gwen, nothing goes as planned. Likewise for Spider-Man, who finally unmasks the Green Goblin.

Entries.Title: Ninja Turtles: The Next Mutation
Entries.Description: Vowing to stop Dragon Lord, Shredder's evil successor, wise Master Chung tells his daughter that she must join the Ninja Turtles to save humankind.

Episodes.Title: East Meets West (1)
Episodes.Description: Vowing to stop Dragon Lord, Shredder's evil successor, wise Master Chung tells his daughter that she must join the Ninja Turtles to save humankind.

Episodes.Title: East Meets West (2)
Episodes.Description: Venus De Milo arrives in New York and introduces herself to the Turtles. Then she reveals that she too was dropped into the toxic sludge at birth.

Episodes.Title: East Meets West (3)
Episodes.Description: Venus leads the Turtles in meditation to help Splinter escape from his dream state, after which they practice martial arts to enter the Dream Realm.

Episodes.Title: East Meets West (4)
Episodes.Description: The Turtles barely escaped the last time they were confronted by Dragon Lord. Now their nemesis has stolen the coveted Serum of Invincibility!

Episodes.Title: East Meets West (5)
Episodes.Description: Donatello and Venus have very different ideas regarding how to neutralize the Serum of Invincibility.

Episodes.Title: The Staff of Bu-Ki
Episodes.Description: Dragon Lord reaches through the time warp to steal the Staff of Bu-Ki, an ancient relic with the power to destroy any and all shinobi spell-casters.

Episodes.Title: Silver and Gold
Episodes.Description: When a series of high-profile bank robberies ravage New York City, the Turtles choose not to get involved right away.

Episodes.Title: Meet Dr. Quease
Episodes.Description: One of Donatello's biggest idols in the world of science, Dr. Quease, is kidnapped by the dragons.

Episodes.Title: All in the Family
Episodes.Description: While on an early-morning sewer jog, the Turtles discover a rare baby Turtle in the underground storage house of crazy poacher Simon Bonesteel.

Episodes.Title: Trusting Dr. Quease
Episodes.Description: When Dragon Lord and Dr. Quease have an argument, Quease propositions Donatello, because he thinks they should work together.

Episodes.Title: Windfall
Episodes.Description: When Michaelangelo finds a winning lottery ticket, he thinks his sewer days are over. But the others have already dreamt of ways to spend the money!

Episodes.Title: Turtles' Night Out
Episodes.Description: After an encounter with Bonesteel, Mikey comes up with an idea -- an all-night rave for animal rights where everybody dresses as their favorite beast.

Episodes.Title: Mutant Reflections
Episodes.Description: Our heroes have a hard time sorting out who's who when their evil counterparts start popping up everywhere -- and they all look like the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Truce or Consequences
Episodes.Description: The dragons are tired of Dragon Lord's oppressive regime, and want to help the Turtles send him back into the mirror. Are they for real?

Episodes.Title: Sewer Crash
Episodes.Description: As Donatello is scanning the Web for information, someone breaks into his computer and sends him a coded message -- one that reprograms Donny's brain!

Episodes.Title: Going Ape
Episodes.Description: Raphael is enjoying one of his favorite pastimes -- harassing crazed poacher Simon Bonesteel -- when a platoon of Rank warriors join in the game.

Episodes.Title: Enemy of my Enemy
Episodes.Description: When the Turtles stumble upon a man being attacked by dragons in Central Park, they are shocked to learn they've rescued someone from their past!

Episodes.Title: King Wick
Episodes.Description: When an alchemy accident gives Wick telekinetic powers, he not only uses it over the Dragon Lord, but he puts the Ninja Turtles to the test too!

Episodes.Title: The Good Dragon
Episodes.Description: When Venus's life is saved by one of the Dragon Lord's Rank warriors, the Turtles are forced to re-examine their views on dragons.

Episodes.Title: The Guest
Episodes.Description: When his apartment burns down, Splinter's chess opponent moves in with the Turtles for a few days.

Episodes.Title: Like Brothers
Episodes.Description: The continuing conflict between Raphael and Donatello comes to a head... again. This time, however, Mike and Leonardo get dragged into it.

Episodes.Title: Unchain My Heart (1)
Episodes.Description: While the Turtles are busy evading Bonesteel, an old enemy of Chung I's arrives in New York to destroy Chung I's former student: Venus.

Episodes.Title: Unchain My Heart (2)
Episodes.Description: Raphael and the Turtles go against the wishes of Venus and Splinter and return Vam Mi's heart. Yet the vampires are determined to destroy Venus.

Episodes.Title: Unchain My Heart (3)
Episodes.Description: Bonesteel is sick and tired of the immortal bloodsuckers getting in the way of his efforts to capture the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Unchain My Heart (4)
Episodes.Description: With the Turtles being held hostage by Bonesteel, it's up to Splinter and Venus to defeat the vampires once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Who Needs Her
Episodes.Description: When Venus accidentally traps someone in a forcefield, they begin to question her value to the team, recounting her numerous mistakes in the past.

Entries.Title: Marvel's Ultimate Spider-Man
Entries.Description: One year after becoming Spider-Man, a teenage Peter Parker is approached by Nick Fury to train with S.H.I.E.L.D. Spidey turns Fury down, but soon finds that villainous forces may require him to join the big leagues after all.

Episodes.Title: Great Power
Episodes.Description: One year after becoming Spider-Man, a teenage Peter Parker is approached by Nick Fury to train with S.H.I.E.L.D. Spidey turns Fury down, but soon finds that villainous forces may require him to join the big leagues after all.

Episodes.Title: Great Responsibility
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man accepts Nick Fury’s offer to become the Ultimate Spider-Man and meets his new allies of young heroes consisting of Nova, White Tiger, Power Man and Iron Fist. Meanwhile, Norman Osborn orders Doctor Octopus to send the Frightful Four to target Spider-Man. Spider-Man ends up having to get help from his new allies to fight off the Frightful Four.

Episodes.Title: Doomed
Episodes.Description: After a childish argument between Spider-Man and Nova gets their entire team grounded, the super-youths go through S.H.I.E.L.D.'s database of the most wanted supervillains to see who they can defeat and apprehend in order to impress Nick Fury. When the choices Batroc the Leaper, Blizzard, Melter, MODOK, Toad, Whirlwind, and Lady Porcupine prove unpopular, Spider-Man and his team go to Latveria to track down Doctor Doom. The young heroes fairly easily capture Doom, but things take a turn for the worst when Doctor Doom tricks the team into taking one of his Doombots aboard the Helicarrier.

Episodes.Title: Venom
Episodes.Description:
Under the supervision of Osborn, Doctor Octavius obtains a sample of Spider-Man's blood in order to create a creature that rivals the powers of the wall crawler.

 

Meanwhile, Peter attempts to balance his friendship with Harry with his time with his SHIELD teammates.

Episodes.Title: Flight of the Iron Spider
Episodes.Description: When Spider-Man meets his idol Iron Man, he receives a specialized gift: the Iron Spider suit. However, Spider-Man experiences difficulty learning how to use the suit and begins to neglect his teammates. Meanwhile, the heroes battle the Living Laser, who takes advantage of Spider-Man's lack of experience using the new suit.

Episodes.Title: Why I Hate Gym
Episodes.Description: Taskmaster goes undercover and infiltrates Peter's school to seek out Spider-Man. Spider-Man and White Tiger must put their differences aside and find a way to defeat an opponent who can mimic all of their physical abilities.

Episodes.Title: Exclusive
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man agrees to a video interview with budding news reporter Mary Jane Watson, who gets a more exclusive scoop than she could ever have anticipated when Spider-Man and The Incredible Hulk engage in an all-out battle against Zzzax throughout Manhattan.

Episodes.Title: Back in Black
Episodes.Description: It is bad enough Spider-Man catches a cold, but things drop from bad to worse when a new Spider-Man dressed in black attempts to replace him. Are his friends right and is his jealousy is getting the best of him, or is the new Spider-Man Venom's latest victim?

Episodes.Title: Field Trip
Episodes.Description: While on a field trip, Spider-Man and his superhero friends encounter the mighty Thor, who is transformed into a frog by his mischievous half-brother Loki. Now, the heroes must venture to the magical world of Asgard in order to save the nine realms from Loki's wrath.

Episodes.Title: Freaky
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Wolverine must overcome clashing personalities and styles in order to defeat Mesmero and Sabretooth.

Episodes.Title: Venomous
Episodes.Description: Venom resurfaces, using Harry as his host, yet again, and this time Harry's neglecting father becomes his main target. While Norman Osborn does not want his potential secret weapon damaged, Spider-Man is confronted with the dilemma of either trying to help Harry on his own or putting his trust in his teammates, who have orders from Fury to finish Venom off.

Episodes.Title: Me Time
Episodes.Description: After a fight with Whirlwind, Spider-Man insists on a weekend off from Nick Fury and S.H.I.E.L.D.. Unfortunately, Doctor Octopus chooses this very time to attack Spider-Man when his job is threatened by Norman Osborn.

Episodes.Title: Strange
Episodes.Description: When New York is plunged into a mystical sleep, Iron Fist and Spider-Man (who is at first highly sceptical of magic) seek the help of Doctor Strange. In order to break the spell, the three heroes must face their own worst fears in the face of the spell's initiator, the extradimensional entity known as Nightmare.

Episodes.Title: Awesome
Episodes.Description: Peter Parker scrambles to focus his attention between completing his science fair project with Luke Cage and combatting Juggernaut. In his desperation concerning the first case, he decides to "borrow" one of Dr. Connor's inventions ... which (literally) becomes an even bigger threat to the city.

Episodes.Title: For Your Eye Only
Episodes.Description: After being late for training, Spider-Man is faced against an evil super army called Zodiac and their leader, Scorpio, who took over the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier and set it on self-destruct. Spider-Man and Fury must put their differences aside and fight the new menace as a team.

Episodes.Title: Beetle Mania
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and his team are put on S.H.I.E.L.D. security detail to protect the all-too-critical-for-his-own-health J. Jonah Jameson from the Beetle, a prospect Spider-Man does not enjoy. Things do get personal when Spider-Man must also protect a highly determined Mary Jane, who is on her way to the Bugle for a job interview, from the high-tech villain.

Episodes.Title: Snow Day
Episodes.Description: When Phil Coulson wants the heroes to report to the S.H.I.E.L.D. ice base for winter survival training, Spider-Man and his team sneak off for a vacation on a deserted tropical island that Nova finds under "classy." However, they soon realize something is not right with the island and the Sandman will make sure they never leave.

Episodes.Title: Damage
Episodes.Description: When Spider-Man and his fellow teenage super heroes cause too much damage in a super villain fight, Nick Fury assigns them to work with the super clean-up company Damage Control. While working with Damage Control, Spider-Man uncovers a villainous mystery.

Episodes.Title: Home Sick Hulk
Episodes.Description: Hulk smashes back into Spider-Man’s life where he is sick with an alien infection caused by the Phalanx. Spider-Man has no choice but to take Hulk home and keep him hidden from Aunt May while protecting him from the Phalanx.

Episodes.Title: Run Pig Run
Episodes.Description: Loki exacts revenge on Spider-Man by turning him into a pig, just in time for the Asgardian Boar Hunt across New York City. Now, Thor, who knows all too well how it feels to be transformed into a helpless animal, must help Spider-Ham survive.

Episodes.Title: I Am Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: Flash Thompson stars as Spider-Man in a Midtown High musical production, and gets a taste of what Spider-Man's life is really like when the Trapster mistakes the football jock for the real web-slinger.

Episodes.Title: The Iron Octopus
Episodes.Description: When Doctor Octopus takes over Iron Man's armors, Spider-Man and team work to stop his attacks on Oscorp and S.H.I.E.L.D.

Episodes.Title: Not a Toy
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man loses Captain America's shield and must retrieve it from Doctor Doom.

Episodes.Title: The Attack of the Beetle
Episodes.Description: Aunt May goes on a date with Phil Coulson, Peter's principal and S.H.I.E.L.D. supervisor, and the Beetle returns to continue his evil deeds.

Episodes.Title: Revealed
Episodes.Description: The Green Goblin is created.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of the Goblin
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man tries to protect Harry Osborn from the Green Goblin and Venom.

Episodes.Title: The Lizard
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man returns to stop the nefarious plot of Doctor Octopus. But not everything goes according to plan when Spidey’s friend, Dr. Curt Connors, transforms into The Lizard.

Episodes.Title: Electro
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man's old enemy Electro takes control of the city's electricity.

Episodes.Title: The Rhino
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must stop Rhino’s personal vendetta against Spidey’s least favourite Midtown High classmate: Flash Thompson.

Episodes.Title: Kraven the Hunter
Episodes.Description: White Tiger comes to terms with her powers and origin, while she is hunted by a villain from her past.

Episodes.Title: Hawkeye
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Hawkeye join forces when the Beetle returns to New York City.

Episodes.Title: The Sinister Six
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man gets trapped with six of his most dangerous foes, including Rhino; Kraven the Hunter; Lizard; Electro; Beetle; and a secret sixth member.

Episodes.Title: Spidah-Man!
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man accepts an invitation from Boston to become the city's official hero.

Episodes.Title: Carnage
Episodes.Description: The Green Goblin returns and tries to make Spider-Man into his perfect weapon, but Carnage has other ideas for the duo.

Episodes.Title: House Arrest
Episodes.Description: The security system at Aunt May's home becomes dangerous.

Episodes.Title: The Man-Wolf
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man travels to the moon to rescue J. Jonah Jameson's son, but a bizarre threat awaits him on the lunar surface.

Episodes.Title: Swarm
Episodes.Description: A disgruntled Stark Industries scientist named Michael Tan develops and envelops himself in a swarm of self-replicating nanobots. Now Spider-Man must work with Iron Man to contain Swarm.

Episodes.Title: Itsy Bitsy Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: Using a Norn Stone, Loki shrinks Spider-Man's team while looking for Thor. Nick Fury has Spider-Man's team placed in the Helicarrier's D.A.Y.C.A.R.E. area while S.H.I.E.L.D. continues to look for Thor. With Thor also having been shrunk, Spider-Man's team must find a way to help Thor fight Loki and the Destroyer Armor and return to normal size.

Episodes.Title: Journey of the Iron Fist
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man travels to the mystical city of K’un L’un to help Iron Fist fulfill his destiny. But The Scorpion plans to destroy them both.

Episodes.Title: The Incredible Spider-Hulk
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and The Hulk switch minds, leading to lots of craziness and a clobberin’ from The Thing of The Fantastic Four.

Episodes.Title: Stan By Me
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man, Mary Jane, Harry and Stan the Janitor have to descend into the sewer tunnels beneath Midtown High to track down the Lizard.

Episodes.Title: Ultimate Deadpool
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man spends a day in Deadpool's madcap world.

Episodes.Title: Venom Bomb
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must work with his nemesis, Doctor Octopus, when The Green Goblin unleashes Venom on the Tricarrier.

Episodes.Title: Guardians of the Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Nova team up with The Guardians of the Galaxy on a deep-space adventure to save Earth from destruction.

Episodes.Title: The Parent Trap
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Power Man infiltrate Zodiac's secret volcano base only to discover what really happened to Power Man's long-lost parents.

Episodes.Title: Game Over
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man teams up with The Avengers' Captain America and the X-Men's Wolverine to stop a new threat to S.H.I.E.L.D.

Episodes.Title: Blade
Episodes.Description: It's Halloween for Marvel's Ultimate Spider-Man, but there's no time for Spider-Man and his friends to trick-or-treat when they find themselves attacked by evil vampires led by Dracula himself.

Episodes.Title: The Howling Commandos
Episodes.Description: Spidey's only hope of stopping a world takeover is to team up with Nick Fury's secret team of super-powered monsters, The Howling Commandos. Led by Jack Russell, aka Werewolf by Night, The Howling Commandos include vampire hunter Blade, The Living Mummy, Frankenstein's Monster and Man-Thing.

Episodes.Title: Second Chance Hero
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man forms an unlikely partnership with a cured Norman Osborn. But is Norman really a hero as the Iron Patriot?

Episodes.Title: Sandman Returns
Episodes.Description: Sandman proves he might not be the biggest bad after all. He's given the chance to start all over and Spidey must mentor his former foe as he struggles against his old instincts. What side will Sandman ultimately choose, hero or villain?

Episodes.Title: Return of the Sinister Six
Episodes.Description: Doc Ock launches a surprise attack on Spider-Man and the heroes. They soon find themselves in one of the most challenging battles of the season when they're up against the newly reformed Sinister Six. Norman Osborn also returns as Iron Patriot despite Ock's alternate plans for him.

Episodes.Title: Ultimate
Episodes.Description: Doc Ock launches a surprise attack on Spider-Man and the heroes. They soon find themselves in one of the most challenging battles of the season when they're up against the newly reformed Sinister Six. Norman Osborn also returns as Iron Patriot despite Ock's alternate plans for him.

Episodes.Title: The Return of the Guardians of the Galaxy
Episodes.Description: The Guardians of the Galaxy land on Earth to repair their ship at the same time ex-Nova Corps member Titus leads the Chitauri into targeting Nova's helmet. Now Spider-Man and Nova must work with the Guardians of the Galaxy to defeat Titus and the Chitauri.

Episodes.Title: The Avenging Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man's dream of joining the Avengers becomes a nightmare when Loki switches bodies with the web-slinger, turning his new teammates against him. Spider-Man and his friends team up with the Avengers to stop Loki and Doctor Octopus from destroying New York City with an army of Venomized monsters.

Episodes.Title: Agent Venom
Episodes.Description: While trying to become a crime fighter, Flash Thompson gets permanently bonded with Venom. It's up to Spider-Man to rescue his one-time school bully from the attentions of Venom, Beetle and Taskmaster. In the end, Nick Fury decides to give Spider-Man his list of teenaged superheroes.

Episodes.Title: Cloak & Dagger
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man wants to recruit Cloak and Dagger as new warriors for his S.H.I.E.L.D. team. Complicating the matter, however, are Dormammu taking control of Cloak and Dr. Strange in an attempt to invade Earth, and Cloak and Dagger's own trust issues.

Episodes.Title: The Next Iron Spider
Episodes.Description: Science genius Amadeus Cho proves perfect to operate the Iron Spider armor. The only trouble is he's Peter Parker's class rival.

Episodes.Title: The Vulture
Episodes.Description: A mysterious thief known as The Vulture has been causing trouble. Spider-Man decides to track him down, and discovers he's a young man who has trouble remembering his past.

Episodes.Title: The Savage Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man accompanies Wolverine to the Savage Land to recruit Ka-Zar and his pet smilodon Zabu. During this time, they discover a plot by Taskmaster and Kraven the Hunter to abduct Zabu as part of Kraven the Hunter's ritual that would render him immortal.

Episodes.Title: Halloween Night at the Museum
Episodes.Description: The cast of "Jessie" gets animated in this special crossover episode that finds the Manhattan nanny in possession of a medieval sword coveted by the infamous Morgan Le Fey. Jessie and Spider-Man team up to save Halloween and the world from Le Fay's evil plans.

Episodes.Title: New Warriors
Episodes.Description: Now that the other young heroes have been assembled, Spider-Man must lead them into defending the Tri-Carrier from the Thunderbolts (consisting of Taskmaster, Vulture, and Cloak and Dagger) where they managed to spring Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus, Beetle, and Scorpion from their cells.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare on Christmas
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man sees what the world would be like without him when Nightmare takes the web-slinger on a journey through his past, present, and future.

Episodes.Title: The Spider-Verse (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man learns that the Green Goblin is planning to travel across the Multiverse using the Siege Perilous he stole from S.H.I.E.L.D. and the energy of Electro to collect the DNA of other Spider-Men. Spider-Man follows his enemy to the futuristic world of Marvel 2099 (which is drawn in CGI) and helps boost the confidence of Spider-Man 2099. Then he travels to a gender-swapped universe and teams up with Spider-Girl to defeat their world's versions of the Green Goblin.

Episodes.Title: The Spider-Verse (2)
Episodes.Description: While chasing Green Goblin across the Multiverse, Spider-Man arrives in the Marvel Noir universe where he helps Spider-Man Noir renew his friendship with Marry Jane. Then Spider-Man heads to a cartoonish world inhabited by anthropomorphic animals where he helps Peter Porker find the will to be Spider-Ham again.

Episodes.Title: The Spider-Verse (3)
Episodes.Description: As Spider-Man continues chasing Green Goblin across the Multiverse, he lands in a medieval-based world where he helps Spyder-Knight take down the Alchemist (the medieval version of Doctor Octopus) and his Kraken creation to save York. Then, his last stop before heading back home is an alternate version of the Ultimate Universe where he helps Miles Morales overcome the guilt of being unable to save his world's Peter Parker from death and fight the Ultimate Green Goblin.

Episodes.Title: The Spider-Verse (4)
Episodes.Description: After Spider-Man finally ends up back in his own universe, he finds Green Goblin has injected himself with the Spider-Men DNA from all the universes to become the Spider-Goblin. With Electro's help from the Siege Perilous, he summons all the Spider-Men dubbed Web-Warriors to battle the Spider-Goblin and save New York even when Electro plans to destroy it.

Episodes.Title: S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy
Episodes.Description: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy has been opened up at the Triskelion by Nick Fury as Spider-Man's group gets their education from Mr. Frank and guest instructors like Captain America and Hawkeye. Halfway into their education, Spider-Man and Iron Spider unknowingly reactivate an old World War II villain named Arnim Zola.

Episodes.Title: The Rampaging Rhino
Episodes.Description: When Rhino learns that his archenemy Flash has become a hero, he starts a bitter rampage through New York. Spider-Man and Agent Venom are the last line of defense with help from Hulk. However, Hulk and Rhino face in battle and only Spider-Man and Agent Venom should stop now so to not cause destruction.

Episodes.Title: Ant-Man
Episodes.Description: Nick Fury has been infected by nanite versions of Doctor Octopus' Octo-Bots. While the others face off against Doctor Octopus, Spider-Man and Power Man work with Ant-Man to enter Nick Fury's body and get the Octo-Bots out of him.

Episodes.Title: Burrito Run
Episodes.Description: Craving Mexican food following an entire day training with Hawkeye, Spider-Man, Power Man, and Squirrel Girl sneak out of the Triskelion after hours for late-night burritos. Along the way, they must contend with Mesmero's plot to use the cellular network to brainwash everyone like he did with Batroc the Leaper, Boomerang, Grizzly, and Shocker.

Episodes.Title: Inhumanity
Episodes.Description: Following Spider-Man's fight with Molten Man, the Inhumans have declared war on Manhattan as Nick Fury blames the exchange student Triton. Spider-Man and Triton discover that Maximus has brainwashed the rest of the Inhuman Royal Family (consisting of Black Bolt, Medusa, Gorgon, Lockjaw and Karnak) and plans to crash Attilan into Manhattan.

Episodes.Title: Attack of the Synthezoids
Episodes.Description: Arnim Zola resurfaces and starts replacing Spider-Man's fellow students with synthezoid versions of themselves.

Episodes.Title: The Revenge of Arnim Zola
Episodes.Description: With most of his fellow students replaced with synthezoids, Spider-Man must work with Agent Venom and Rhino to rescue their classmates and defeat Arnim Zola.

Episodes.Title: Contest of Champions (1)
Episodes.Description: The Collector and the Grandmaster capture Spider-Man, along with every hero, villain and citizen of New York to play a game that will decide the fate of the entire planet.

Episodes.Title: Contest of Champions (2)
Episodes.Description: The Collector and the Grandmaster's game continues as Spider-Man teams up with members from the Avengers and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. to play for the fate of the planet.

Episodes.Title: Contest of Champions (3)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man has to change the rules of The Grandmaster's game to save the citizens of New York and prevent the villains from taking over Earth.

Episodes.Title: Contest of Champions (4)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man fights side-by-side with The Collector in an attempt to free all of Earth's heroes and villains from the Grandmaster and set everything right again.

Episodes.Title: Hydra Attacks (1)
Episodes.Description: Peter Parker learns Doctor Octopus has teamed up with Arnim Zola and Hydra to attack the Tri-Carrier, leaving S.H.I.E.L.D. caught off-guard and Spider-Man left to single-handedly stop the assault. He assembles a new team, including an apprehensive Scarlet Spider, in order to stop the villains from taking over New York.

Episodes.Title: Hydra Attacks (2)
Episodes.Description: After being saved by Scarlet Spider following Arnim Zola's takeover of the S.H.I.E.L.D. Tri-Carrier, Spider-Man must work with him to liberate Manhattan and his fellow students from HYDRA's clutches. Even when they save Agent Venom and Iron Spider, they must also undo transformations of the HYDRA Goblins, avoid Doctor Octopus and Kraven the Hunter, and defeat Arnim Zola.

Episodes.Title: Miles from Home
Episodes.Description: After learning that Norman Osborn injected himself with an Anti-Goblin serum to prevent further transformations into Green Goblin following the last encounter, Doctor Octopus teams up with Baron Mordo and uses the Siege Perilous to pull the Ultimate Green Goblin from Miles Morales' universe into theirs so that HYDRA can be his master. Now Spider-Man and Miles have to work together with Doctor Strange to keep the demonic Goblin from using the Siege Perilous to destroy reality.

Episodes.Title: Iron Vulture
Episodes.Description: With the Siege Perilous destroyed in the aftermath of the fight with the Ultimate Green Goblin, Miles Morales is forced to stay in Spider-Man's reality until S.H.I.E.L.D. can find a way to get him and his world's Goblin back to their home. Now dubbed Kid Arachnid, he and Spider-Man must help Norman Osborn when he is targeted by Doctor Octopus and Vulture.

Episodes.Title: Lizards
Episodes.Description: Dr. Curt Connors has been turned into Lizard again. This time, he has a bite that turns anyone who is bitten into Lizards. The Triskelion goes under lockdown when Spider-Man's team and the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy personnel get infected and attack Spider-Man. With help from an item in Nick Fury's office and with the help of Iron Spider, Leo Fitz, and Jemma Simmons, Spider-Man must work on an antidote in order to restore everyone to normal. Meanwhile, Agent Venom and Rhino guard Doctor Octopus' cell during the outbreak just in case he plans any escapes from his cell. Once everyone is cured, Spider-Man witnesses Doctor Octopus and Rhino making off with Agent Venom.

Episodes.Title: Double Agent Venom
Episodes.Description: After Doctor Octopus and Rhino have escaped the Triskelion with Agent Venom in their clutches, Spider-Man and Scarlet Spider track them to the recently-returned HYDRA Island as Doctor Octopus and Arnim Zola work to separate the Venom symbiote from Flash Thompson. In order to get to Flash, Spider-Man and Scarlet Spider have to fight their way past Kraven the Hunter and the HYDRA Agents. Ock Manages to succeed in separating the symbiote from Flash, giving to Kraven, who becomes a lion-like Venom. However, Flash is able to coerce the symbiote back to him as they understand each other. As a result of the re-fusion, Agent Venom gains a new look.

Episodes.Title: Beached
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man, Iron Spider, Agent Venom, Kid Arachnid, and Scarlet Spider have been looking for signs on where Doctor Octopus is hiding out. Upon Spider-Man and Iron Spider being ambushed by Vulture, they follow him to a nearby island where they are attacked by clones of Sandman. As Spider-Man fights the Sandman clones, Iron Spider stumbles upon a secret laboratory where Doctor Octopus has captured Sandman and cloned him so that he can find the "Ultimate Sandman" that will join the Sinister Six. After Sandman is rescued and Doctor Octopus escapes, Spider-Man allows Sandman to spread out around the Triskelion.

Episodes.Title: Anti-Venom
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Agent Venom have been busting villains like Beetle, Grizzly, Shocker, and Shriek where they suspect that they might be candidates for Doctor Octopus' Sinister Six. Arnim Zola recruits Michael Morbius to work on a new symbiote. When Spider-Man, Agent Venom, and Harry Osborn in the Patrioteer armor track them down, they are caught off-guard when they release the Anti-Venom symbiote which possesses Harry and does not have any of the symbiote weaknesses. The resulting battle leaves Agent Venom injured and Harry in a coma.

Episodes.Title: Force of Nature
Episodes.Description: During a drought, Spider-Man, Iron Spider, Kid Arachnid, and Scarlet Spider answer a distress signal that takes them to an abandoned mall in Queens. They find an empty air-tight room containing Hydro-Man who has a past with Nick Fury. While transporting him to the Triskelion, Iron Spider find that Hydro-Man is not a good guy where the fight with him causes an emergency landing near Aunt May's house. While Spider-Man, Iron Spider, and Kid Arachnid fight Hydro-Man, Scarlet Spider works to protect Aunt May who ends up naming him Ben. Once Hydro-Man is defeated where the resulting battle watered Aunt May's lawn, Spider-Man gets word that the Quinjet carrying Hydro-Man back to his cell was intercepted causing Spider-Man to speculate that Doctor Octopus has gotten Hydro-Man on his side.

Episodes.Title: The New Sinister Six (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man faces the culmination of all Doc Ock's evil machinations when the new Sinister Six assaults the Web Warriors and S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy at the Triskelion.

Episodes.Title: The New Sinister Six (2)
Episodes.Description: When Doc Ock learns that the key to a device that will retrieve Hydra Island is at Aunt May's house, Spider-Man must fight to protect his family.

Episodes.Title: Agent Web
Episodes.Description: When a battered Nova asks for help finding Nick Fury, Spider-Man tracks him to the dangerous ruins of an ancient city.

Episodes.Title: The Symbiote Saga (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Agent Venom discovered Hydra and Morbius' plan to create a new and improved Venom Bomb.

Episodes.Title: The Symbiote Saga (2)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man, Captain America and S.H.I.E.L.D Academy must band together to save New York.

Episodes.Title: The Symbiote Saga (3)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and his fellow heroes have to Morbius and his plan to use the Carnage Queen as a weapon.

Episodes.Title: Return to the Spider-Verse (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Kid Arachnid travel to alternate dimensions to gather the shards from the broken Siege Perilous.

Episodes.Title: Return to the Spider-Verse (2)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Miles, tracking the missing pieces of the Siege Perilous, travel to a tropical Pirate dimension where they meet Web Beard, the Spider-Pirate, and encourage him and his old team to work together to save themselves from the dreaded Kraken.

Episodes.Title: Return to the Spider-Verse (3)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Kid Arachnid arrive in the Noir Universe where they have to prevent Mr. Negative from using the Siege Perilous to drain all the life and color out of the world.

Episodes.Title: Return to the Spider-Verse (4)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man, having collected all of the shards of the Siege Perilous, returns to Miles Morales' universe and confronts Wolf Spider.

Episodes.Title: Strange Little Halloween
Episodes.Description: Trick-or-treaters start turning into monsters and Spider-Man, Dr. Strange and Ant-Man must team up to stop Baron Mordo.

Episodes.Title: The Spider Slayers (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must team with the former traitor, Scarlet Spider, to stop Doc Ock from reawakening a secret program designed to create evil duplicates of Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: The Spider Slayers (2)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Scarlet Spider have to infiltrate the sunken Hydra Island so Scarlet can destroy the lab that created him.

Episodes.Title: The Spider Slayers (3)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man puts the Triskelion on lockdown when a mysterious villain begins to take out the heroes one at a time.

Episodes.Title: The Moon Knight Before Christmas
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man house sits on Christmas Eve and is forced to team up with Moon Knight to defend the home from the new Mysterio.

Episodes.Title: Graduation Day (1)
Episodes.Description: Spidey must track down Ock before he harms Aunt May.

Episodes.Title: Graduation Day (2)
Episodes.Description: Peter Parker must find a way to stop Doctor Octopus and the Superior Sinister Six from destroying all of the heroes in New York and taking over the world.

Entries.Title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
Entries.Description: The Turtles discover for the first time that they are not the weirdest things in New York when they encounter two villains from the Hidden City pursing a cat-like agent. They have their first encounter with Baron Draxum who is making mutants with the help of his Oozesquitos.

Episodes.Title: Mystic Mayhem
Episodes.Description: The Turtles discover for the first time that they are not the weirdest things in New York when they encounter two villains from the Hidden City pursing a cat-like agent. They have their first encounter with Baron Draxum who is making mutants with the help of his Oozesquitos.

Episodes.Title: Donnie's Gifts
Episodes.Description: Donnie creates new gear for his brothers in order for them to overcome their bad habits. However, the gear only becomes a nuisance as they fight mutated chef dubbed Meat Sweats, who plans to cook the turtles in order to gain their powers.

Episodes.Title: War and Pizza
Episodes.Description: In order to save April's job as a party captain at Albearto's Pizzeria, Donnie upgrades the main animatronic of Albearto, only for it to go out of control.

Episodes.Title: Down with the Sickness
Episodes.Description: Splinter has come down with the rat flu, and the Turtles must deal with its 7 different stages involving fever, "Wild Rat Man", "Captain Cuddle Cakes", "Ninja Supreme", karaoke love songs, and fan fiction. The Turtles hope that Splinter will make to the final stage called "Must Say Yes" so that they can ask him for whatever they want.

Episodes.Title: Shell in a Cell
Episodes.Description: Leo unseats Raph's wrestling idol Ghostbear from his title as the champion of the world after accidentally falling on him from the rafters. Raph soon becomes irked by Leo's cockiness and decides to wrestle him himself. When Ghostbear joins the fight, Raph learns that Ghostbear doesn't play by the rules.

Episodes.Title: Repo Mantis
Episodes.Description: Mikey and Donnie try to get a Jupiter Jim moon buggy vehicle from a repo yard, where they run afoul of its owner Repo Mantis. In exchange for the prop vehicle, Mikey and Donnie are hired as repo men and are sent to repossess an RV on Long Island. However, the deal deteriorates when they meet the RV's possessor, a kind mutant named Todd Capybara, and his puppies.

Episodes.Title: The Fast and the Furriest
Episodes.Description: When Donnie's newly-built Turtle Tank goes missing, he and the Turtles must find it. While going after some usual suspects, they are unaware that the Turtle Tank was taken by Splinter, who is additionally invited to "dinner" with Meat Sweats.

Episodes.Title: Origami Tsunami
Episodes.Description: Longing for the excitements of hero life, Leo talks the team into tracking down the paper thief duo currently stalking the city. In doing so, the Turtles run into the Foot Clan, who use their mystic ability to create origami warriors from the stolen paper.

Episodes.Title: Mascot Melee
Episodes.Description: While looking for gifts for Splinter, the Turtles traverse through Times Square where they fight the thuggish mascots lurking there.

Episodes.Title: Newsworthy
Episodes.Description: To prove himself as the greatest enemy of the Turtles, former news anchor-turned-mutant earthworm Warren Stone gets in the way of the Turtles as they track down Hypno-Potamus, who is abducting the animal partners of other magicians.

Episodes.Title: Minotaur Maze
Episodes.Description: After the Turtles stumble across a pizza restaurant in the mystical Undercity while following a Fire Yōkai, Leonardo drags his brothers into a pizza-shaped Maze of Death to obtain the ultimate prize....a free helping to the titular parlor's "world's greatest pizza". But in order to claim it, they will have to contend with the pizza's guardian in the form of the Minotaur who is the maze's assistant manager.

Episodes.Title: The Longest Fight
Episodes.Description: The Turtles have a hard time watching their skateboarding idol Sydney Allen on the "Extreme Skateboarding Finals" and stopping a burglary at Gilbert's Department Store conducted by the Foot Clan at the same time.

Episodes.Title: The Gumbus
Episodes.Description: Leo, Mikey and April investigate a mysterious specter haunting a themed supermarket called Stock 'n Shop, which leads to their encounter with Baxter Stockboy.

Episodes.Title: Mrs. Cuddles
Episodes.Description: April and the brothers make Raph face his greatest fear: an adorable kids' TV show rabbit named Mrs. Cuddles. However, things aren't so funny anymore when Mrs. Cuddles suddenly comes to life and begins hunting the Turtle family to feed on their fears.

Episodes.Title: Hypno! Part Deux
Episodes.Description: Hypno-Potamus returns and causes havoc at April's homecoming dance by hypnotizing the attendees.

Episodes.Title: Stuck on You
Episodes.Description: After an unfortunate glue accident, the Turtles have to fight a whole host of villains like the Mutant Silverfish, the Foot Clan, Hypno-Potamus, and Warren Stone while literally being stuck together.

Episodes.Title: Bug Busters
Episodes.Description: The Turtles look for a way to eliminate New York City's Oozesquito problem.

Episodes.Title: Al Be Back
Episodes.Description: The Turtles plan their first public musical gig at Albearto Land. When it happens, it gets crashed by Albearto and his army of animatronic bears from failed Albearto's fastfood franchises.

Episodes.Title: The Evil League of Mutants
Episodes.Description: The Turtles end up facing a new and dangerous threat in their beloved city as Baron Draxum, Huginn, and Muninn gather some of their toughest mutant enemies like Meat Sweats, Hypno-Potamus, Warren Stone, Repo Mantis, and the Sando Brothers in a plot to destroy them.

Episodes.Title: The Purple Jacket
Episodes.Description: During a visit in April's school, Donatello becomes enamored with an exclusive tech club, the Purple Dragons, and joins them on the spot. However, when the Dragons abuse his tech for criminal purposes, Donatello is forced to choose between stopping the crooks and losing his treasured purple membership jacket.

Episodes.Title: Pizza Pit
Episodes.Description: DIGG, a trio of unsuccessful girl musicians mutated into burrowing animals, begin sinking the Turtles' favorite pizza places into the ground, prompting the Turtles to go after them before they have no place left to get their favorite food.

Episodes.Title: Smart Lair
Episodes.Description: To ease their household chores, Donatello invents a new artificial intelligence, S.H.E.L.L.D.O.N., who begins to see exclusively to his creator's needs. Disgruntled, Raphael, Michelangelo and Leonardo choose to rewire the robot, which leads to near-fatal consequences for their brother.

Episodes.Title: Hot Soup: The Game
Episodes.Description:
Mikey goes on a solo mission to retrieve a classic video game based on Lou Jitsu's film Hot Soup. Incidentally, however, he will have to contend with the Foot Clan's new recruit who is on a very similar mission at the very same auction house.

Note: Ice Cream Kitty from the previous series makes a cameo as a statue.

Episodes.Title: Late Fee
Episodes.Description: The simple task of returning a single DVD just before its loan period runs out is complicated by endless craziness in New York, including an encounter with Ghostbear.

Episodes.Title: Bullhop
Episodes.Description: Things go sour when the Turtles try to help a down-and-out mutant in the form of the bellhop-turned-mutant bull from "Bug Busters" while at the same time planning a raid to obtain more of Big Mama's web goo. Bullhop eagerly decides to help his benefactors out.

Episodes.Title: Mind Meld
Episodes.Description: Frustrated by his brothers' childishness during an important mission, Donatello enhances their intelligence. However, things get quickly out of hand when they begin displaying Donatello's personality traits as well.

Episodes.Title: Nothing But Truffle
Episodes.Description: When Michelangelo and Todd Capybara spy on Meat Sweats in order to learn his most delicious recipe, the Turtle and the mutant chef become BFFs after Meat Sweats accidentally absorbs Todd's niceness. The two of them go on a look for the extremely rare lunar truffle that only grows when the Moon is in alignment with Jupiter, and face its Were-Tree guardian.

Episodes.Title: Portal Jacked!
Episodes.Description: Leo loses his brothers in a portal and must venture to the mystic Hidden City to save them. He finds that they are on the pirate ship run by Capitán Piel.

Episodes.Title: Sparring Partner
Episodes.Description: Raph becomes friends with a new sparring partner in the form of Frankenfoot and must keep it secret from his brothers, who don't like the guy. When Frankenfoot is driven from the lair, this gives the Foot Lieutenant and the Foot Recruit the opportunity to take it into the Foot Clan.

Episodes.Title: Shadow of Evil
Episodes.Description: As the Turtles try to find pieces of a strange metal Baron Draxum is looking for, Splinter intents to get to the bottom of odd goings-on at April's new job at the Foot Shack. He soon learns that the Foot plan to resurrect their ancient master the Shredder by reassembling the Kuroi Yoroi armor. As the parties clash, the secrets of Splinter's past finally come to light.

Episodes.Title: Warren & Hypno, Sitting in a Tree
Episodes.Description: Baron Draxum, Huginn, and Muninn want the gauntlet that Warren Stone has since it's part of the Kuroi Yoroi armor, but he's not giving it up without a fight and a side of betrayal. As the Turtles get involved with Warren's roommate Hypno-Potamus being threatened, April remembers who Warren Stone is as she was part of a fan club dedidicated to him called the Stoneheads.

Episodes.Title: Operation: Normal
Episodes.Description: Leo and Donnie try desperately to help April enjoy a quiet day with a new friend named Sunita. They learn that she is a slime Yōkai who uses a special amulet to turn into a human. They soon get targeted by the Foot Clan since the boots that Sunita's human form is wearing are part of the Kuroi Yoroi.

Episodes.Title: You Got Served
Episodes.Description: Señor Hueso has just remembered that an ogre gang called the Makers of Brutality and a reptilian gang called the Makers of Barbarianism have book reservations at Run of the Mill Pizza. While helping Señor Hueso at Run of the Mill Pizza since his employees have fled, Leo and Mikey get sidetracked by brotherly competition. They must overcome this to keep the peace while trying not to wreck Run of the Mill Pizza.

Episodes.Title: How to Make Enemies and Bend People to Your Will
Episodes.Description: Baron Draxum struggles to move up the ladder in the Foot Clan while Foot Recruit was displeased that she hasn't gotten her mark yet. Upon finding a loophole where a Foot Clan member who can outdo an acting leader can assume this position, Baron Draxum leads the Foot Recruit into organizing a blunder for the Foot Lieutenant and the Foot Brute when the next Kuroi Yoroi fragment is at the botanical gardens. Meanwhile, the Turtles hold a contest to see who can withstand the smell of the corpse flower at the same botanical gardens.

Episodes.Title: Mystic Library
Episodes.Description: The Turtles plumb the depths of a mysterious hidden library in search of a way to rescue Mayhem from April's mirror. While trying to be quiet, they must also evade not having a sound heard by the Bat Librarian's Hush-Bats and contend with the Foot Lieutenant and Foot Brute.

Episodes.Title: The Purple Game
Episodes.Description: When a competitive new video game sweeps New York, Donnie will do anything to reach rank No. 1. Though Donnie is unaware that the video game was created by the Purple Dragons.

Episodes.Title: Man vs. Sewer
Episodes.Description: The Turtles lazy river ride through the sewers turns savage when Raph's separated and left alone.

Episodes.Title: The Mutant Menace
Episodes.Description: The Turtles' failed attempts to do good deeds turn all of New York against them.

Episodes.Title: Turtle-dega Nights: The Ballad of Rat Man
Episodes.Description: Splinter enters the Turtle Tank in a demolition derby.

Episodes.Title: The Ancient Art of Ninja Hide and Seek
Episodes.Description: Splinter teaches his sons the Art of Ninja Concealment.

Episodes.Title: One Man's Junk
Episodes.Description: The Turtles try to recover a piece of the Dark Armor from Repo Mantis' scrap yard.

Episodes.Title: Snow Day
Episodes.Description: A ferocious mutant tries to ruin April and the Turtles fun day in the snow.

Episodes.Title: Cloak and Swaggart
Episodes.Description: April and Sunita search New York for Sunita's stolen cloaking brooch.

Episodes.Title: Jupiter Jim Ahoy!
Episodes.Description: The Turtles meet their favorite sci-fi movie star, Jupiter Jim.

Episodes.Title: Insane in the Mama Train
Episodes.Description: With the dark armor nearly complete, the Turtles decide to get serious and embrace their ninja heritage.

Episodes.Title: End Game
Episodes.Description: Splinter and the Turtles must prevent Baron Draxum from getting the final piece of the Kuroi Yōroi.

Episodes.Title: Flushed But Never Forgotten
Episodes.Description: The Turtles have a secret that comes back to haunt them in the form of Splinter's pet goldfish Piebald who was accidentally flushed down the toilet and mutated after eating an Oozesquito.

Episodes.Title: Lair Games
Episodes.Description: April presents her award-winning documentary about the Turtles’ annual event: The Lair Olympics.

Episodes.Title: Many Unhappy Returns
Episodes.Description: The TMNT must stop a persistent foe from shredding NYC, but problems arise when they split up to handle things.

Episodes.Title: Todd Scouts
Episodes.Description: The TMNT need to learn how to listen and get in touch with nature in order to save Todd after he's captured by a group of hunters.

Episodes.Title: Goyles Goyles Goyles
Episodes.Description: Huginn and Muninn recall their first day working for Baron Draxum.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Purple
Episodes.Description: Donnie's parenting causes S.H.E.L.L.D.O.N. to run away.

Episodes.Title: Repairin' the Baron
Episodes.Description: Mikey tries to get Draxum to tolerate humans.

Episodes.Title: Air Turtle
Episodes.Description: Leo gets his dream job as mascot of the local professional basketball team.

Episodes.Title: Pizza Puffs
Episodes.Description: Ralph teaches his brothers a lesson in responsibility.

Episodes.Title: Sidekick Ahoy!
Episodes.Description: With their favorite space hero movie star in need of a sidekick, the TMNT do all they can to win their dream job.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden City Job
Episodes.Description: Leo and Senor Hueso help the reformed Capitan Piel on one last dangerous mission.

Episodes.Title: Always Be Brownies
Episodes.Description: April and Splinter encounter a gang of dangerous middle school brownie sellers.

Episodes.Title: Mystery Meat
Episodes.Description: Baron Draxum's lunchroom concoction comes to life and terrorizes April's school.

Episodes.Title: Raph's Ride-Along
Episodes.Description: Raph is mistaken for a heinous criminal in the Hidden City.

Episodes.Title: Donnie vs. Witch Town
Episodes.Description: Always a man of science, Donnie can't accept April going to the witches for mystic help on a science project.

Episodes.Title: Hidden City's Most Wanted
Episodes.Description: Splinter's magical day with Mikey is interrupted by a mysterious and tiny guest.

Episodes.Title: Bad Hair Day
Episodes.Description: Leo's efforts to get into an exclusive Hidden City spa threaten to unweave his day of relaxation.

Episodes.Title: Fists of Furry
Episodes.Description: April and the Turtles must help Splinter save his chain of dojos from being taken over by an evil rival.

Episodes.Title: The Clothes Don't Make the Turtle
Episodes.Description: Hypno-Potamus traps the Turtles in a magical 80s movie montage.

Episodes.Title: Battle Nexus: New York
Episodes.Description: Big Mama turns New York City into her new Battle Nexus arena and The Turtles have to fight to save everyone they love.

Episodes.Title: Finale Part 1: E-Turtle Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (1)
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must enter Splinter's mind when a powerful foe returns.

Episodes.Title: Finale Part 2: Shreddy or Not (2)
Episodes.Description: The Turtles find a new ally when they meet Splinter's distant relative.

Episodes.Title: Finale Part 3: Anatawa Hitorijanai (3)
Episodes.Description: In a bid to save New York and the Hidden City, The Turtles prepare for their greatest battle yet.

Episodes.Title: Finale Part 4: Rise (4)
Episodes.Description: When the Turtles find their ninpo, they must defeat the Shredder once and for all.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man and His Amazing Friends
Entries.Description: Norman Osborne's plane crashes, causing him to change once again into the Green Goblin. He decides his new evil plan will be to pollute the resevoir with the same formula used to create him, thereby making an entire city of goblins.

Episodes.Title: Triumph of the Green Goblin
Episodes.Description: Norman Osborne's plane crashes, causing him to change once again into the Green Goblin. He decides his new evil plan will be to pollute the resevoir with the same formula used to create him, thereby making an entire city of goblins.

Episodes.Title: The Crime of All Centuries
Episodes.Description: Kraven the Hunter captures Firestar and attempts to unleash a Dinosaur Army.

Episodes.Title: The Fantastic Mr. Frump!
Episodes.Description: Dr. Doom unwittingly enables an old man with powers which he uses to his bidding.

Episodes.Title: Sunfire
Episodes.Description: The team meets the Japanese superhero and battles his evil uncle's fire monster.

Episodes.Title: Swarm
Episodes.Description: When a meteor crashes to Earth mutating the inhabitants of a nearby bee hive, the result is Swarm. A living creature composed entirely of the bodies of thousands of bees, he is bent on turning Earth's entire population into humanoid bees.

Episodes.Title: 7 Little Superheroes
Episodes.Description: Captain America, Shanna the She-Devil, Namor the Sub-Mariner, Dr. Strange, and the Spider Friends face off against The Chameleon on Wolf Island.

Episodes.Title: Video-Man
Episodes.Description: Electro creates a super-villian named Video Man from an arcade game to undo the Spider-Friends.

Episodes.Title: The Prison Plot
Episodes.Description: Magneto holds a prison island hostage and will throw off the Earth's gravitational hold until the prison agrees with Magneto to release the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants even though the Spider-Friends are also his hostage.

Episodes.Title: Spidey Goes Hollywood
Episodes.Description: When unfortunate accidents stop movie-maker Sam Blockbuster from completing his Spider-Man movie, Mysterio is revealed as the source of all the previous mishaps during shooting. Mysterio blackmails Blockbuster into hiring the real Spider-Man to star in his own movie.

Episodes.Title: The Vengeance of Loki!
Episodes.Description: The Spider-Friends team up with Thor to stop Loki and his latest plot to destroy New York City with a defrosted Viking ship and the Viking that came with it.

Episodes.Title: Knights and Demons
Episodes.Description: The Spider-Friends and the Black Knight follow the evil sorcerer Mordred to the Land of Shades.

Episodes.Title: Pawns of the Kingpin
Episodes.Description: Dr. Faustus and The Kingpin use "Psycho-Disks" in order to mind control Captain America and Iceman into doing the Kingpin's bidding.

Episodes.Title: The Quest of the Red Skull
Episodes.Description: The Red Skull captures the Spider-Friends and Hiawatha Smith while trying to start World War 3.

Episodes.Title: The Origin of the Iceman
Episodes.Description: This episode tells us the origin of Iceman from his first use of his powers to the time he was with the X-Men after somehow losing his powers before telling the Spider-Friends his origin.

Episodes.Title: A Fire-Star is Born
Episodes.Description: The X-Men have a reunion, which Ice Man and Firestar attend.

Episodes.Title: Along Came Spidey
Episodes.Description: When Aunt May is injured during a confrontation between the Spider friends and the Shocker, Peter confides his origin to his friends.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Man Unmasked!
Episodes.Description: While The Spider-Friends are vacationing, The Sandman shows up and discovers Spider-Man's true identity, but the Spider-Friends try to convince him that he's wrong.

Episodes.Title: The Bride of Dracula!
Episodes.Description: While at a dance, Angelica is lured outside by a stranger and hypnotized. The stranger takes her aboard his plane and they go to Transylvania, but not without Iceman and Spider-Man right behind them. The stranger is revealed to be Dracula. They get Angelica free, but still have to fight against Frankenstein and a werewolf.

Episodes.Title: The Education of a Superhero
Episodes.Description: The Gamesman has developed a machine that will hypnotize young people through video arcade machines. Through a glitch, caused by Gamesman's machine, in the arcade machine a young, nerdy teenager named Francis Byte was playing, Franis developed the ability to turn himself into a self proclaimed hero called Video Man. Unfortunately he doesn't know how to be a superhero. While battling Thee Gamesman, the Spider-Friends help Video Man out. But in the end, the best help is found at the mansion of Professor Charles Xavier.

Episodes.Title: Attack of the Arachnoid
Episodes.Description: A woman named Monica video taped a successful fight between the Spider-Friends and The Scorpion. Zoltan Amadaeus is collecting data on Spider-Man and plans to retain the powers of Spider-Man and use them for his own gain and framing the real Spider-Man. But problem's arise when the Zoltan's powers change him into a half man/half spider creature called The Arachnoid.

Episodes.Title: The Origin of the Spider-Friends
Episodes.Description: Stan Lee narrates how Spider-Man, Iceman and Firestar first joined forces to battle the Beetle, and become known as the Spider-Friends.

Episodes.Title: Spidey Meets the Girl from Tomorrow
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man meets whom he believes is the love of his life - an alien from the future named Ariel, whose spaceship crash-lands on earth. As Spidey tries to nurture his relationship with Ariel, Doctor Octopus steals the spaceship to carry out a plan to kidnap well-armed criminals from the future.

Episodes.Title: The X-Men Adventure
