Episodes.Description: The Turtles and Splinter use Virtual Reality technology to learn of the Utrom's presence and purpose on Earth, but an old enemy believed dead returns to make the journey VERY real...

Episodes.Title: Secret Origins (3)
Episodes.Description: The Turtles and Splinter escape the Utrom's virtual reality device, but now they must escape TCRI before it is destroyed. Buttheir only way out is hampered by one small obstacle: SHREDDER AND THE FOOT!

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Ninja
Episodes.Description: The Ultimate Ninja, a warrior from across the galaxies, has come to take the head of Shredder - only to find Leonardo has already done the deed. So now The Ultimate Ninja challenges Leonardo in a battle to the death...

Episodes.Title: Reflections
Episodes.Description: The Turtles retreat to Casey Jone's Grandmother's farm house to reflect on their recent battles. But the figure of the Shredder still haunts their every memory. What is the Shredder's connection to the Turtles origins?

Episodes.Title: Modern Love - The Return of Nano
Episodes.Description: When Nano returns to take revenge on the Turtles, the four brothers must stop his rampage. But this is made more difficult when Nano springs his "Father" from prison...

Episodes.Title: What a Croc
Episodes.Description: The Turtles are about to discover that the Mutagen that transformed them, has had an effect on other creatures as well. They must now defend their territory from the rampage of the insidious alligator Leatherhead...

Episodes.Title: Return to the Underground
Episodes.Description: The Turtles return to the underground city but they find the city is now abandoned, it's crystal moon power source missing, and it's human population reduced to monsters. Can an unstable serum created by Donatello restore the humans to normal?

Episodes.Title: City at War (1)
Episodes.Description: The collapse of Shredder's crime empire means the city is open for the most vicious gangs to seize control for themselves. New York is plunged into chaos and anarchy, and only the Turtles can maintain order..or can they?

Episodes.Title: City at War (2)
Episodes.Description: The Turtles are caught in a power struggle for the city : The Foot, the Purple Dragons, and the Mob, all want a piece of the pie. Are the boys able to save the city from anarchy? And is it their problem in the first place?

Episodes.Title: City at War (3)
Episodes.Description: With the Foot, the Purple Dragons, and the Mob becoming more than the Turtles can handle, the TMNT reluctantly call on the help of Shredder's old General: Karai.

Episodes.Title: Junklantis
Episodes.Description: Whilst testing out their new Shell Sub, the Turtles are forced to sink or swim when they discover their old enemy Garbageman is creating his own underwater city.

Episodes.Title: The Golden Puck
Episodes.Description: Casey Jones joins the sport of Super Slam Hockey. However it turns personal when a legendary 17th century Golden Puck is taken by crooks. Can the Turtles hold Casey in line long enough to find the Puck, or will the hardcore rules of Super Slam Hockey get to them first?

Episodes.Title: Rogue in the House (1)
Episodes.Description: Shredder deploys an army of Foot Mechs and a Cyborg duplicate of Splinter against the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Rogue in the House (2)
Episodes.Description: Shredder's army of Foot Mechs confront the Turtles, but even if they defeat this army, can they stop Shredder? And how does a Triceraton warrior called Zog fit into it all?

Episodes.Title: April's Artifact
Episodes.Description: The Turtles help April unlock the secrets of an ancient Puzzle cube left behind by her father. The puzzle's solution takes April and the Turtles on a journey of discovery..to another dimension filled with giant insects!

Episodes.Title: Return of the Justice Force
Episodes.Description: Michelangelo's quest to collect a rare comic take the TMNT and Casey Jones back to Northampton, Massachusetts. Here they uncover a plot by a madman to kidnap the members of a retired super-hero team called The Justice Force.

Episodes.Title: Big Brawl (1)
Episodes.Description: Every three years, Splinter leaves his students to go to parts unknown. Curious, the four Turtles decide to follow him this time. The pursuit of their master leads the Turtles into something they never expected, right into the middle of the "Big Brawl" : The Battle for the Nexus, a brutal tournament where fates will be decided...

Episodes.Title: Big Brawl (2)
Episodes.Description: The Turtles discover more about their master Splinter as the Battle Nexus tournament continues. They also have a run-in with a warrior who Splinter defeated in the tournament three years ago: Lord Draco.

Episodes.Title: Big Brawl (3)
Episodes.Description: The Battle Nexus tournament begins to take it's toll on the TMNT : Leonardo is poisoned, Splinter is framed, and Lord Draco moves closer to victory.

Episodes.Title: Big Brawl (4)
Episodes.Description: The Battle Nexus Tournament nears it's conclusion : Dontello finds himself fighting for his life with Usagi Yujumbo as Mikey is poised to become Battle Nexus Champion. Leonardo's condition worsens, and Splinter is still in prison. Worse still, Lord Draco now has control of the Daimyo Warstaff...

Episodes.Title: Within the Woods
Episodes.Description: The team tries to deal with the possibility that Leo will not get better; a new mutant captures Raphael.

Episodes.Title: A Foot Too Big
Episodes.Description: When the Turtles discover Bigfoot in the woods, Donnie befriends it and insists they protect it from a hunter.

Episodes.Title: Buried Secrets
Episodes.Description: When the guys discover a Kraang ship buried under April's house, they also uncover April's lost mother.

Episodes.Title: The Croaking
Episodes.Description: When he gets upset, Mikey flees and befriends a mutant frog in the woods, only to learn the frog and his family have nefarious plans.

Episodes.Title: In Dreams
Episodes.Description: When the Turtles are trapped in their dreams by creatures, April and Casey must figure out how to wake them up.

Episodes.Title: Race with the Demon!
Episodes.Description: When Casey and Donatello bond while building Casey's new hot rod, the bond is challenged by a hot-rodding mutant.

Episodes.Title: Eyes of the Chimera
Episodes.Description: When Casey, Raph, Mikey and Donnie are captured by a new mutant, April and Leo must overcome disabilities in order to save them.

Episodes.Title: Vision Quest
Episodes.Description: Leo takes the Turtles to train in the woods in an advanced ninja ritual; the Turtles must overcome their weaknesses and face their enemies to become a true ninja.

Episodes.Title: Return to New York
Episodes.Description: When the Turtles return to the city to search for Splinter, they discover that the city has been overrun with Kraang.

Episodes.Title: Serpent Hunt
Episodes.Description: As the Turtles search for Karai, they are forced to deal with a city filled with Kraangdroids as well as Zeck and Steranko.

Episodes.Title: The Pig and the Rhino
Episodes.Description: Donnie finishes a new batch of retro-mutagen in hopes of saving Karai; the Turtles are hunted by Shredder's new henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady.

Episodes.Title: Battle for New York (1)
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must brave the bizarre world of Dimension X to save the enslaved people of New York. Part 1

Episodes.Title: Battle for New York (2)
Episodes.Description: Part 2

Episodes.Title: Casey Jones vs the Underworld
Episodes.Description: Casey Jones thinks he can take on the criminal underworld on his own, but soon discovers that he is in over his head.

Episodes.Title: The Noxious Avenger
Episodes.Description: A new and unfamiliar mutant known as Muckman begins to gain notoriety as New York City's "Monster Hero."

Episodes.Title: Clash of the Mutanimals
Episodes.Description: The Shredder kidnaps and experiments on the Mighty Mutanimals.

Episodes.Title: Meet Mondo Gecko
Episodes.Description: Michelangelo and Casey become friends with Mondo Gecko, a radical, skateboarding, reptilian teenager.

Episodes.Title: The Deadly Venom
Episodes.Description: When Karai is brainwashed, she begins hunting the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Turtles in Time
Episodes.Description: When the Turtles are whisked through time by apprentice Time Master Renet, they all must work together to defeat the evil Time Master Savanti Romero.

Episodes.Title: Tale of the Yokai
Episodes.Description: When the Turtles are accidentally transported to the past, they happen to cross paths with a familiar ninja clan.

Episodes.Title: Attack of the Mega Shredder!
Episodes.Description: Leonardo decides to sneak into Shredder's lair alone, and winds up facing the biggest mutant threat yet.

Episodes.Title: The Creeping Doom
Episodes.Description: After an accident, Donnie finds himself slowly losing his intelligence.

Episodes.Title: The Fourfold Trap
Episodes.Description: After being kidnapped by the hypnotized Karai, the Turtles are placed in deadly traps that they must work together in in order to escape. Splinter, in his efforts to save the turtles, is forced to face Karai in order to free her from Shredder's control.

Episodes.Title: Dinosaur Seen in Sewers!
Episodes.Description: Raphael meets a confused alien dinosaur named Zog, the Triceraton.

Episodes.Title: Annihilation: Earth! (1)
Episodes.Description: When the turtles get word of the Kraang's return, they realize there is an even bigger threat coming to Earth.

Episodes.Title: Annihilation: Earth! (2)
Episodes.Description: When the turtles get word of the Kraang's return, they realize there is an even bigger threat coming to Earth.

Episodes.Title: Beneath these Streets
Episodes.Description: The Turtles learn the cost of slacking off when Splinter is badly hurt during a confrontation with Shredder.

Episodes.Title: Turtles On Trial
Episodes.Description: The intentions of the Ninja Turtles are put to the test when a controversial TV-figure portrays our heroes as menaces to society.

Episodes.Title: Attack of the 50-Foot Irma
Episodes.Description: Irma accidentally becomes gigantic and her naturally clumsy nature makes her a danger to the city.

Episodes.Title: The Maltese Hamster
Episodes.Description: Gangsters are swiping all the antiques in town. And when they swipe most of our heroes, it's up to Donatello and April to find out why. Could Shredder be behind this?

Episodes.Title: Sky Turtles
Episodes.Description: The Turtles go flying when the Shredder invents a gravity-altering device.

Episodes.Title: The Old Switcheroo
Episodes.Description: The personalities of Shredder and Splinter are switched when a device is accidentally activated during a battle between the Turtles and their enemies. As Shredder plans the Turtles' demise and Splinter plans on how to get back to his body, everyone else is clueless.

Episodes.Title: Burne's Blues
Episodes.Description: In the middle of a summer heat wave, someone is destroying all the air conditioners and taking all the city's freon. In the meantime, Vernon and Burne go looking for the Turtles, but find something else.

Episodes.Title: The Fifth Turtle
Episodes.Description: A 14-year-old boy tries his best to help out the Turtles, but with some not so optimal results.

Episodes.Title: Enter: The Rat King
Episodes.Description: Thompson assigns April to research the growing rat infestation. She is pursued by an army of rats and escapes on a passing city bus.

Episodes.Title: Turtles at the Earth's Core
Episodes.Description: Dinosaurs invade the Big Apple. Befriending a young diplodocus the Turtles trace the invading dinosaurs to their source finding a lost world.

Episodes.Title: April Fool
Episodes.Description: Emperor Aleister of Malicuria comes to New York City, bringing along a shard of Lydium 90 to the USA.

Episodes.Title: Attack of the Big MACC
Episodes.Description: A robot warrior arrives from 400 years in the future in 20th-Century New York.

Episodes.Title: The Ninja Sword of Nowhere
Episodes.Description: Krang's computers detect an alien metal on the surface of the Earth. Krang sends Shredder, along with an Alien Metal Detector, to the surface to find it.

Episodes.Title: 20.000 Leaks Under the City
Episodes.Description: Still searching for a way to destroy the Turtles, Krang develops a super pump that he intends to use to flood the sewers.

Episodes.Title: Take Me to Your Leader
Episodes.Description: Full of self doubt, Leonardo leaves the team. Michaelangelo, Raphael, and Donatello all take turns being leader as they try to figure out why the sun is getting smaller.

Episodes.Title: Four Musketurtles
Episodes.Description: A bump on the head leaves Leonardo thinking that he is in 17th century France, and that he and his comrades are Musketeers.

Episodes.Title: Turtles, Turtles Everywhere
Episodes.Description: Shredder programs the city's new garbage collecting super-computer to collect the Turtles. But when Shredder doesn't specify 'Ninja' Turtles, the super-computer collects them all! Turtles of the city of every shape and size are not safe.

Episodes.Title: Cowabunga Shredhead
Episodes.Description: The Shredder thinks he's Michaelangelo after a computer malfunction.

Episodes.Title: Invasion of the Turtle Snatchers
Episodes.Description: Aliens abduct Donatello and Rocksteady.

Episodes.Title: Camera Bugged
Episodes.Description: A visit to Earth from a Polarisoid results in havoc when Shredder comes into possession of the alien's camera, because it does more than just take pictures.

Episodes.Title: Green with Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Krang sets his sights on a powerful Nuclear-Powered Submarine, believing it's fuel will be more than enough to power the technodrome.

Episodes.Title: Return of the Fly
Episodes.Description: Baxter Stockman returns for revenge against the Turtles and Shredder, while our heroes attempt to stop Shredder's plan to siphon water from an underground reservoir.

Episodes.Title: Casey Jones: Outlaw Hero
Episodes.Description: An eager vigilante is causing a stir in the city, while Krang and Shredder take control of all the machines in the city. Maybe this new 'hero' can help the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Mutagen Monster
Episodes.Description: In an attempt to hijack two separate trains carrying the ingredients needed to make mutagen, Rocksteady and Bebop cause their head-on collision, resulting in the spillage of both chemicals in the city's train yard.

Episodes.Title: Corporate Raiders from Dimension X
Episodes.Description: High ranking corporate executives are kidnapped by men in business suits. The Turtles don't get involved until they learn that one of these corporations is the world's largest suppliers of pizza.

Episodes.Title: Pizza by the Shred
Episodes.Description: Michaelangelo gets a job as a pizza delivery boy. But who's his new boss?

Episodes.Title: Super Bebop & Mighty Rocksteady
Episodes.Description: Shredder and Krang produce hi-tech versions of Rocksteady and Bebop to keep the Turtles busy.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Lotus
Episodes.Description: A skilled, and lovely, ninja warrior is hired by Krang to defeat the Turtles. Shredder's replaced, Leonardo's met his match.

Episodes.Title: Blast from the Past
Episodes.Description: Splinter suffers amnesia as the Turtles try to remind him that he is the true leader of the Foot Clan.

Episodes.Title: Leatherhead: Terror of the Swamp
Episodes.Description: While Raphael is reliving the past, via the Turtles' photo album, their frog friends in the Florida Swamps are being terrorized by a mutant alligator known as Leatherhead.

Episodes.Title: Michaelangelo's Birthday
Episodes.Description: It's Michaelangelo's birthday, but none of his brothers seem to remember, and it frustrates him greatly.

Episodes.Title: Usagi Yojimbo
Episodes.Description: A rabbit ronin warrior from an alternate dimension is lost in our world. While the Turtles help him adjust, Shredder steals a dragon egg to unleash it on the city.

Episodes.Title: Case of the Hot Kimono
Episodes.Description: Someone is stealing all the kimonos in the city. After Master Splinter's favorite kimono is stolen, April's famous detective aunt helps the Turtles retrieve it.

Episodes.Title: Usagi Come Home
Episodes.Description: Shredder tricks Usagi Yojimbo into battling the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: The Making of Metalhead
Episodes.Description: While the Turtles are suffering from turtle pox, a disease that affects only mutant Turtles, Krang has developed a robotic turtle that he calls Metalhead.

Episodes.Title: Leatherhead Meets the Rat King
Episodes.Description: Leatherhead has come to the city searching for the Turtles. While crawling through the sewers he encounters the Rat King who charges him with trespassing.

Episodes.Title: The Turtle Terminator
Episodes.Description: Irma is kidnapped by Bebop and Rocksteady and is replaced by a robot that looks just like her that is programmed to eliminate the turtles.

Episodes.Title: The Great Boldini
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must clear their names when they are believed to be jewel thieves who stole a priceless emerald during a magic act run by a wizard named Boldini.

Episodes.Title: The Missing Map
Episodes.Description: Zach and his brother Walt visit the Turtles. As they leave, Walt takes a map that could guide Shredder to the lair if it happens to fall into the wrong hands.

Episodes.Title: The Gang's All Here
Episodes.Description: Shredder tries to trick the Turtles into eating cookies made with anti-mutagen. Michaelangelo, wanting to be a human, tries one of the cookies and it mutates him into a teenager.

Episodes.Title: The Grybyx
Episodes.Description: Kala's pet Grybyx, which has a really bad temper whenever it gets hungry, escapes from Dimension X through a portal to Earth, causing trouble for the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Mister Ogg Goes to Town
Episodes.Description: While searching for a device to transform crude oil into liquid hydrogen, Krang accidentally brings Mr. Ogg from Dimension Z to earth.

Episodes.Title: Shredderville
Episodes.Description: The Turtles are frustrated that they let Shredder slip away from them again. They feel like giving up, and wish they had never been born.

Episodes.Title: Bye Bye Fly
Episodes.Description: An interdimensional alien spacecraft leads Baxter Stockman to his latest vengeful plot to destroy the Turtles and Shredder.

Episodes.Title: The Big Rip Off
Episodes.Description: After several failed attempts to get the Technodrome re-energized, Shredder and Krang run one last-ditch distraction for the Turtles at Fort Charles while Bebop and Rocksteady steal energy fuel cells from the neighboring space research center.

Episodes.Title: The Big Break In
Episodes.Description: The Technodrome is up and running again, and it is up to the Turtles to hinder Shredder and Krang from getting to the surface.

Episodes.Title: The Big Blow Out
Episodes.Description: After several setbacks, Shredder and Krang steal all of New York's electricity and charge it into a giant transdimensional gateway, designed to send Earth into Dimension X. The Turtles must defeat their enemies once and for all before Earth is destroyed by Krang's Rock Soldier army.

Episodes.Title: Space Invaders (1)
Episodes.Description: The Triceratons have invaded looking for the Fugitoid. Unfortunately, no one on Earth knows what the heck the big horn heads are talking about.

Episodes.Title: Space Invaders (2)
Episodes.Description: Having managed to rescue Casey and April from becoming slaves, the turtles have lost Donatello to the Triceratons. Donatello tries desperately to convince Prime Leader Zanramon that the Fugitoid is not on Earth!

Episodes.Title: Space Invaders (3)
Episodes.Description: Searching for the captive Donatello, Leonardo, Raphael and Michelangelo sneak their way into Republic Central, the hub of the Triceraton Homeworld.

Episodes.Title: Worlds Collide (1)
Episodes.Description: Just when the turtles think everything's under control with the Triceratons leaving fully convinced the Fugitoid is not on planet Earth, the Fugitoid shows up!

Episodes.Title: Worlds Collide (2)
Episodes.Description: Just when our four turtles thought they had fooled the Triceratons and disguised the Fugitoid, they find themselves captives of the Military.

Episodes.Title: Worlds Collide (3)
Episodes.Description: At the secret Federation/military base, the turtles are about to be dissected by Agent Bishop, a very bad resident of planet Earth. Luckily, our odd trio of commandos (Splinter, April and Casey) are moving in for the rescue.

Episodes.Title: Touch and Go
Episodes.Description: Welcome to the New World...same as the Old World. While the Turtles attempt to assess the damage around their lair, they find that adjusting to their post alien invasion lives might be harder than they thought.

Episodes.Title: Hunted
Episodes.Description: For a two ton reptile, Leatherhead actually makes the ideal houseguest; neat, tidy, always pays his rent on time... except for the fact that his temper is really out of control.

Episodes.Title: H.A.T.E
Episodes.Description: Donatello, Michelangelo and Raphael come across a band of crazed, heavily armed, alien-hating Survivalists, bent upon delivering and detonating a thermo nuclear device in New York City.

Episodes.Title: Nobody's Fool
Episodes.Description: When Michelangelo and Leonardo are out getting a little night air, they cross paths with a caped crusader who ends up saving their lives. The Turtles soon learn that he's really a cop who is out to get the one man who ruined his career.

Episodes.Title: The Lesson
Episodes.Description: April asks the Turtles to help perfect her ninjitsu skills. But the Turtles are reluctant to do so and recount a story about how they once tried to take a "student" under their wing. They just weren't prepared to be teachers.

Episodes.Title: The Christmas Aliens
Episodes.Description: Christmas is supposed to be a time of giving, not taking! But when a dangerous gang of thieves hijack a truck full of holiday toys on it's way to an orphanage, it's time for Michelanglo to start passing out some season's beatings!

Episodes.Title: New Blood
Episodes.Description: The "savior" of New York City, Oroku Saki, has another face: the Shredder. The turtles stumble upon the Shredder's real reason for "helping" New York.

Episodes.Title: The Darkness Within
Episodes.Description: When Angel's brother disappears in the Wall Street area, the turtles jump to help her. Turns out that, as a result of all the destruction from the invasion, an ancient horror has been stirred.

Episodes.Title: Mission of Gravity
Episodes.Description: The Shredder sends Stockman and Hun on a quest to retrieve an Antigravity Generator from the city of Beijing, which is still floating in the upper atmosphere, thanks to the Triceratons.

Episodes.Title: The Entity Below
Episodes.Description: The Entity and his kind are awakened through a rare planetary alignment, and, harnessing great power, they proceed to start shifting the tectonic plates in order to bring back their world.

Episodes.Title: Time Travails
Episodes.Description: The turtles get sucked into a time traveling adventure by the somewhat vapid but totally cute Renet, Apprentice Timestress.

Episodes.Title: Hun on the Run
Episodes.Description: Hun's always been loyal, but too many failures have tarnished his relationship with his master. But when Karai is captured by Bishop, the Shredder gives Hun a mission in which he can redeem himself: save Karai and bring her back alive.

Episodes.Title: Reality Check
Episodes.Description: Ultimate Drako is back and he's causing all sorts of chaos with the Time Scepter. He's sent the four turtles spinning through time into alternate realities.

Episodes.Title: Across The Universe
Episodes.Description: Because of Ultimate Drako's machinations, Raphael finds himself in an alternate reality... of the Planet Racers. This is right down Raphael's alley... until that alley turns into a dead end and he's heading right for it!

Episodes.Title: Same as It Never Was
Episodes.Description: Ultimate Drako's time manipulations have sent Donatello to an alternate reality... and it's not pretty. It's one possible future, a horrible nightmare. The Shredder is all powerful.

Episodes.Title: The Real World (1)
Episodes.Description: Ultimate Drako is causing trouble with the Time Scepter. He blasts Leonardo into another dimension... Usagi Yojimbo's dimension.

Episodes.Title: The Real World (2)
Episodes.Description: Leonardo and Usagi arrive in the Battle Nexus hoping for a way to reunite the four turtles and their master. But they find the Battle Nexus under the control of the evil Ultimate Drako and Master Splinter is his prisoner.

Episodes.Title: Bishop's Gambit
Episodes.Description: Bishop is back and making his move. His research demands a mutated specimen closer to human... a rat: Master Splinter. Bishop kidnaps Splinter and moves to finish the creation of his genetically enhanced super soldiers.

Episodes.Title: Exodus (1)
Episodes.Description: Splinter receives a vision of his Master Yoshi...and a mission. He must stop the Shredder. Time is running out. He doesn't know how to explain it to his sons, but they need no explanation. They're with their father to the bitter end.

Episodes.Title: Exodus (2)
Episodes.Description: The Shredder is leaving Earth in a spaceship of his own construction intent upon wreaking havoc on the Utroms and the galaxy. But he's taken on some unwanted passengers and they're not about to let the Shredder get away.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Known Universe
Episodes.Description: The Turtles experience outer space and alien life for the first time.

Episodes.Title: The Moons of Thalos 3
Episodes.Description: The Turtles and their enemy crash-land on an ice moon and they must put aside their differences in order to survive.

Episodes.Title: The Weird World of Wyrm
Episodes.Description: Casey releases a wish-granting alien named Wyrm, who wants his freedom to do whatever he wants to the universe

Episodes.Title: The Outlaw Armaggon!
Episodes.Description: A shark-like bounty hunter is hired by Lord Dregg to destroy the turtles, who choose to hide out in an abandoned space station.

Episodes.Title: Riddle of the Ancient Aeons
Episodes.Description: The team must journey through an ancient alien temple to get a piece of the black hole generator.But they get an ancient star which marks the Aeons

Episodes.Title: Journey to the Center of Mikey's Mind
Episodes.Description: When microscopic aliens invade Mikey's mind, the Turtles have to chase them through the strange world of Mikey's subconscious.

Episodes.Title: The Arena of Carnage
Episodes.Description: The turtles are captured and thrown into the Triceratons' battle area.

Episodes.Title: The War for Dimension X
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must gain the trust of the Utrom Council in order to find the next piece of the black hole generator.

Episodes.Title: The Cosmic Ocean
Episodes.Description: The Turtles journey through an ocean-like area of space.

Episodes.Title: Trans-Dimensional Turtles
Episodes.Description: The Turtles are transported to another dimension where they meet their 1980s counterparts and work together to battle Krang.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of the Triceratons
Episodes.Description: Donatello is feeling inferior to Fugitoid, but his intellect is put to the test when the Triceratons attack.

Episodes.Title: The Evil of Dregg
Episodes.Description: When Raphael loses his fighting mojo, he must overcome his feelings to save his brothers from certain doom.

Episodes.Title: The Ever-Burning Fire
Episodes.Description: The team must overcome impossible odds in order to obtain the final Black Hole Generator piece that is located on the planet Magdomar.

Episodes.Title: Earth's Last Stand
Episodes.Description: As the team finally reaches Earth, the Fugitoid reveals a horrible secret about his past.

Episodes.Title: City at War
Episodes.Description: April faces a deadly, new enemy when she graduates to full Kunoichi; the Turtles must deal with the return of some old foes.

Episodes.Title: Broken Foot
Episodes.Description: When Leonardo secretly allies himself with Karai, he gets himself into deeper danger than he could have realized.

Episodes.Title: The Insecta Trifecta
Episodes.Description: Raphael must overcome his fear of insects to lead the team when they are forced to battle Stockman-Fly's new insect minions.

Episodes.Title: Mutant Gangland
Episodes.Description: Don Vizioso's gang tracks the Turtles with a slew of Anti-Mutant weapons.

Episodes.Title: Bat in the Belfry
Episodes.Description: Michelangelo befriends some odd, new superheroes named Wingnut and Screwloose.

Episodes.Title: The Super Shredder
Episodes.Description: For the first time, the Turtles encounter something they cannot defeat – the Super Shredder!

Episodes.Title: Darkest Plight
Episodes.Description: The Turtle team hunts for their Sensei, but soon realizes they are being hunted as well.

Episodes.Title: The Power Inside Her
Episodes.Description: Donatello becomes concerned and decides to test April, only to discover that her psychic abilities are rapidly growing in power.

Episodes.Title: Tokka vs. the World
Episodes.Description: When Tokka returns after her presumable death, she finds out that her baby has been taken from her. After realizing this she violently searches for her lost baby.

Episodes.Title: Tale of Tiger Claw
Episodes.Description: A dangerous female mutant, by the name of Alopex, appears with a personal vendetta against Tiger Claw. The Turtles, April and Casey try to befriend her, but turns on them and furiously goes after Tiger Claw alone. Unfortunately for her, Tiger Claw has prepared for her unexpected arrival.

Episodes.Title: Requiem
Episodes.Description: Super Shredder has returned with even greater vengeance, forcing the Turtles to enlist the combined aid of Splinter, April, Casey, Karai, Shinigami and the Mighty Mutanimals to destroy him once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Owari
Episodes.Description: With the demise of their beloved father and Karai incapacitated, the Turtles, April, and Casey, infiltrate Super Shredder's new lair to put an end to Oroku Saki once and for all, no matter what it takes.

Episodes.Title: Plan Six From Outer Space
Episodes.Description: With the Technodrome in serious need for new equipment, Bebop and Rocksteady are sent to Earth, disguised in human form, to capture the Channel 6 building and return it to Dimension X.

Episodes.Title: Turtles of the Jungle
Episodes.Description: A professor's new ray-gun causes plants to go wild and his pet ape Jocko to become a giant rampaging monkey. By using the same ray-gun, Donatello is increased to Jocko's size so he can fight the giant ape and save April from him.

Episodes.Title: Michaelangelo Toys Around
Episodes.Description: While trying to see the new toys at the Toy Fair, Michaelangelo stumbles upon a plot to take over a noted toy company.

Episodes.Title: Peking Turtle
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must battle a reanimated Terracotta Army after Shredder steals an energy device shaped like a giant pearl, which is held and guarded by a Jade Dragon.

Episodes.Title: Shredder's Mom
Episodes.Description: New York is in the middle of an induced heat wave caused by Shredder, who must battle the Turtles and deal with his mother, Miyoko Saki, at the same time.

Episodes.Title: Four Turtles and a Baby
Episodes.Description: When General Tragg and his troops attack the Neutrino capital, the Neutrino leaders, Zenter and Gizzla, send their infant daughter Tribble through a portal to Earth, asking the Turtles to look after her, but Tribble causes big trouble for our heroes.

Episodes.Title: Turtlemaniac
Episodes.Description: An eccentric billionaire, Monroe Q. Flem, who is also a collector, wishes to collect every piece of TMNT memorabilia that he can get his evil hands on, including April and the Turtles themselves.

Episodes.Title: Rondo in New York
Episodes.Description: Shredder, Bebop, and Rocksteady are in town to steal a rare new mutagen created by Oswald Dren, a grad student. Some mutagen is accidentally spilled onto a reel of movie film causing monsters to come to life.

Episodes.Title: Planet of the Turtles
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must save the Earth from a massive energy drain and its Apocalyptic result by traveling to another dimension where turtles are the dominant species.

Episodes.Title: Name That Toon
Episodes.Description: A Technodrome computer disguised as an electronic keyboard ends up on Earth, and in the most unlikely of hands.

Episodes.Title: Menace, Maestro Please
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must contend with the "Phantom of the Floxy" while trying to hinder Shredder's latest plan to bring the Technodrome back to earth.

Episodes.Title: Superhero for a Day
Episodes.Description: Gadget Man comes out of retirement after 50 years, but is tricked by Shredder into fighting against the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Back to the Egg
Episodes.Description: Krang hires a multi-dimentional ring-master who intends on making the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles part of his circus by using an anti-aging serum.

Episodes.Title: Son of Return of the Fly II
Episodes.Description: Vengeful Baxter Stockman and an A.I. computer return to Earth from a dimentional limbo and capture the Turtles while luring Shredder into their trap as well.

Episodes.Title: Raphael Knocks 'em Dead
Episodes.Description: Raphael must contend with a mobster named Pinky McFingers when he is kidnapped from a local comedy club.

Episodes.Title: Bebop and Rocksteady Conquer the Universe
Episodes.Description: On their latest trip to Earth, Bebop and Rocksteady steal a machine that makes everyone scared of everything.

Episodes.Title: Raphael Meets His Match
Episodes.Description: Raphael wins a ticket to a costume party on MacDonald Crump's yacht and decides to go disguised as a Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle.

Episodes.Title: Slash the Evil Turtle from Dimension X
Episodes.Description: Bebop and Rocksteady use Krang's new Mutagen on Bebop's pet turtle Slash so he can do their housework for them. Slash runs away and is conned by an irritated entrepreneur into framing the TMNT.

Episodes.Title: Leonardo Lightens Up
Episodes.Description: A ray-gun makes Leonardo carefree and ignore his responsibilities. This leaves the Turtles defenseless and the city at the mercy of Maestro G Clef, a villain who destroys the city with music.

Episodes.Title: Were-Rats from Channel 6
Episodes.Description: After many failed attempts from his rodent subjects to find food, the Rat King learns of an abandoned canister of mutagen lost in the sewers and claims it for himself.

Episodes.Title: Funny, They Shrunk Michaelangelo
Episodes.Description: While Michaelangelo is testing out a sailboard in the sewers he accidentally gets swept out into the city harbor.

Episodes.Title: The Big Zipp Attack
Episodes.Description: Krang sends Shredder, Bebop and Rocksteady to find Rigidium to repair the Technodrome. A meteorite lands containing a large egg. The egg hatches, revealing a Zipp, a cute little creature that begins to eat the Technodrome.

Episodes.Title: Donatello Makes Time
Episodes.Description: Professor Lloyd Cycloyd, a crazy scientist who escaped from an institution, accidentally discovers the Turtles' lair. He sees Donatello testing out one of his new inventions, a time stopper.

Episodes.Title: Farewell, Lotus Blossum
Episodes.Description: While on their way to a movie, the Turtles rescue the Urn of Chakahachi from two thieves. The thieves pry off a pearl from the Urn before the Turtles get their hands on it.

Episodes.Title: Rebel Without a Fin
Episodes.Description: Dr. Polidorius creates a half-man half-fish named Ray. The Doctor has Ray plant explosives in certain parts of the sewer so that he can sink the city beneath the ocean.

Episodes.Title: Rhino-Man
Episodes.Description: J. Gordon Hungerdunger, a Texas millionaire, is holding a best super-hero contest. The winner of the contest will receive the humongous Malaprop Diamond.

Episodes.Title: Michaelangelo Meets Bugman
Episodes.Description: Michaelangelo meets his favourite comic book hero after he saves a weakened Brick Bradley in the sewers, and then he and Bugman take on the evil Electrozapper together.

Episodes.Title: Poor Little Rich Turtle
Episodes.Description: Krang has come up with yet another brilliant plan to free the Technodrome. The evil alien sends Bebop and Rocksteady to kidnap Buffy Shellhammer, 15 year-old CEO of Shellhammer Chemicals.

Episodes.Title: What's Michaelangelo Good For?
Episodes.Description: The Turtles go along with Michaelangelo and his pet pigeon to the zoo so that Dr. Goodfellow can check the bird out.

Episodes.Title: The Dimension X Story
Episodes.Description: Disguised as humans, Rocksteady and Bebop are sent to attach special trans-dimensional thrusters to the Channel Six Building.

Episodes.Title: Donatello's Degree
Episodes.Description: Donatello gets an invitation to accept his degree personally from Professor Sopho at Sopho University. The only problem is that the invitation is addressed to a Miss Donna Tello.

Episodes.Title: The Big Cufflink Caper
Episodes.Description: The Turtles, bored at the lack of action, decide to investigate when they hear that cufflinks are being stolen around the city.

Episodes.Title: Leonardo VS Tempestra
Episodes.Description: The Turtles sneak into an arcade in the middle of the night to play video games. Leonardo gets hooked on a game called Tempestra's Revenge.

Episodes.Title: Splinter Vanishes
Episodes.Description: Returning from another mission, the  Turtles are shocked to discover their mentor has left the lair, leaving behind only a video taped message.

Episodes.Title: Raphael Drives 'Em Wild
Episodes.Description: On his way home from getting pizza Raphael and a cab driver accidentally get exposed to rays from a Personality Transmogrifier.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Donatello Nebula
Episodes.Description: Donatello has created a device to communicate with distant galaxies. While trying to communicate with the Turtle Nebula Donatello accidentally brings a spaceship to Earth.

Episodes.Title: Big Bug Blunder
Episodes.Description: A fly lands in the mutagen and it increases in size. Not being able to control it, Bebop and Rocksteady send the giant insect to Earth.

Episodes.Title: The Foot Soldiers Are Revolting
Episodes.Description: After Bebop and Rocksteady blow another assignment, Shredder fires them and decides to replace them with an intelligent Foot Soldier named Alpha One.

Episodes.Title: Unidentified Flying Leonardo
Episodes.Description: UFO sightings at an upstate farm town known as High Falls, cause April to investigate. Splinter foresees danger clouding April's visit and sends Leonardo to chaperone.

Episodes.Title: Cousin Sid
Episodes.Description: The Turtles hide out at Casey's farm to recover from their battle with the Shredder. However the ghosts of Casey's past come back to haunt him when his cousin Sid arrives with a gang in tow...

Episodes.Title: The Peoples' Choice
Episodes.Description: The Turtles bear witness to a rumble in the urban jungle between two alien princesses, fighting for the right to party and rule. Pistols at twenty paces. Tally ho.

Episodes.Title: A Wing And A Prayer
Episodes.Description: Ascending to new heights, the Turtles aid the winged warrior named Raptarr against the renegade Mephos to save the floating city of the Avians.

Episodes.Title: Sons of the Silent Age
Episodes.Description: The Turtles face a species of the deep, and when April gets too close to the action, she grasps a truth behind the current of environmental consequence.

Episodes.Title: Dragons' Brew
Episodes.Description: Casey and Leo investigate a series of large-scale robberies. Not surprisingly, Hun and the Purple Dragon are to blame. However one of their hauls is a crate that should never have been opened!

Episodes.Title: I, Monster
Episodes.Description: Casey and the Turtles are practising their hide-and-seek skills at an abandoned warehouse complex. All the while, a strangely familiar figure watches them from the shadows - with an army of rats at his command!

Episodes.Title: Grudge Match
Episodes.Description: A return to the Battle Nexus, a time to fight, is Mikey bound for glory once more?

Episodes.Title: All Hallows Theives
Episodes.Description: On Halloween night, a mustachioed man visits April, expressing interest in a rather unusual item: a hideous six-armed idol. But the statue is no ordinary junkshop knickknack; it can be used to invoke a horde of imps that proceed to clean out the city and bring its spoils to their master, a criminal who calls himself The King of Thieves.

Episodes.Title: Bad Day
Episodes.Description: The Turtles learn first hand what it means to have a "Bad Shell Day" as calamity after calamity befalls them. This time the Turtles may not be able to save everybody...

Episodes.Title: Aliens Among Us
Episodes.Description: When the President of the United States arrives in New York City, an invasion of what seems to be aliens attacks at the most inconvenient time. However, the Turtles investigate this "invasion" and find out that  Bishop is behind it. The question is - why?

Episodes.Title: Dragons Rising
Episodes.Description: The Purple Dragons have evolved from a basic street gang to a smuggling syndicate that works throughout New York. Leonardo goes with Casey to put an end to Hun's plans. However, Casey and the recently angry Leo will have to control their own fury if they want to bring justice-- and not just veangeance-- out of this.

Episodes.Title: Still Nobody
Episodes.Description: The Turtles help Nobody protect an old man when he witnesses Jengo, leader of the Turks, harming a Turks member. Can the Turtles and Nobody stop the Turks?

Episodes.Title: Samurai Tourist
Episodes.Description: Usagi and Gen come to New York for a visit with the Turtles. Gen gets a little carried away by the bright lights of the big city and goes wandering off on his own. And if the modern world wasn't dangerous enough, an assassin from Usagi's world has followed Usagi and Gen. His target: Leonardo.

Episodes.Title: The Ancient One
Episodes.Description: It is time for Leonardo to move on. Splinter sends Leo to a new sensei, or rather, a very old sensei. The journey is long and perilous. Can Leonardo look into himself and find the right answers to his questions? Can he even find the right questions?

Episodes.Title: Scion Of The Shredder
Episodes.Description: While Leonardo is in Japan studying with the Ancient One, Karai as the new Shredder makes her attack. Will Leo return to New York? Will he find out what happened to his home and his family? And, have Splinter and Turtles really been destroyed?

Episodes.Title: Prodigal Son
Episodes.Description: Leonardo returns from Japan to find the lair in ruins and his family nowhere to be seen. As he investigates he finds that the Foot is back to full strength - with Karai as their leader. Since the Foot believe Leo to be dead, he puts all that he has learnt from the Anicent One into practice...

Episodes.Title: Outbreak
Episodes.Description: Bishop has too deal with the consequenses of his actions when people and animals all over New York starts mutating into horrible beasts after his "alien" invasion.

Episodes.Title: The Trouble With Augie
Episodes.Description: For several years April's uncle Augustus (aka Augie) has been missing.

Episodes.Title: A Tale Of Master Yoshi
Episodes.Description: When the power goes out in their lair, the Turtles and Splinter gather around the candlelight as Leonardo tells a story he learned from the Ancient One about Splinter's sensei, Hamato Yoshi.

Episodes.Title: The Return Of Savanti (1)
Episodes.Description: Savanti Romero plots his revenge against the Turtles and Renet after they had him banished to the Cretaceous period. Using his magic to manipulate time, Romero lures the Turtles and Renet into a trap to obtain the time sceptre.

Episodes.Title: The Return Of Savanti (2)
Episodes.Description: Having travelled to the past, the Turtles and Renet battle with Savanti Romero and his telepathically controlled dinosaurs as Savanti attempts to change the historic timeline by preventing the dinosaur extinction event.

Episodes.Title: Adventures In Turtlesitting
Episodes.Description: With the outbreak-mutant situation the Turtles feel they have to deal with and Donatello sick his brothers leave him with Casey and April for care. But Donatello is not sick but in the last stages of a second mutation.

Episodes.Title: Good Genes (1)
Episodes.Description: With Donatello sick the Turtles are desperate. So desperate that they decide  to try and sneak into Bishops facility, where they realize they have to make a deal with the devil if they want to cure Donatello

Episodes.Title: Good Genes (2)
Episodes.Description: To cure Donatello the Turtles made a deal with the devil aka Bishop. Now they have to retrive a pendant that is supposed to help Bishop in his research. The thing is that the pendant is in the heart of the Foot-building, and Karai won't just hand it over

Episodes.Title: The Ninja Tribunal
Episodes.Description: After the Turtles were able to cure Donatello's mutation, a group of ninjas confronts the Turtles to tell them about a battle between good and evil that will decide the fate of the world.

Episodes.Title: Scroll of the Demodragon
Episodes.Description: The Turtles believe they have defeated most of their old enemies, but they soon discover that a new evil is rising from the ashes.

Episodes.Title: The Forgotten Swordsman
Episodes.Description: Karai searches for the legendary Kuro Kabuto, claiming to be the rightful heiress of the Foot Clan, when she suddenly encounters an old rival.

Episodes.Title: Heart of Evil
Episodes.Description: Donnie's grudge with Don Vizioso threatens the Turtle's newest mission.

Episodes.Title: End Times
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must defeat the mighty demodragon Kavaxas to prevent him from destroying the world.

Episodes.Title: When Worlds Collide (1)
Episodes.Description: When Mona Lisa suddenly arrives on Earth, Raphael must get her and Bishop to work together to defeat an alien threat and save the Earth

Episodes.Title: When Worlds Collide (2)
Episodes.Description: The Newtralizer returns to New York City, more powerful than ever before, and joins forces with a dangerous and unexpected ally. With the help of Raphael's Salamandrian girlfriend, Mona Lisa, the Turtles fight back to defend their city.

Episodes.Title: Yojimbo
Episodes.Description: The Turtles are transported to an alternate dimension, where they befriend the rabbit samurai and master swordsman: Miyamoto Usagi.

Episodes.Title: Osoroshi no Tabi
Episodes.Description: Usagi leads the Turtles through a haunted forest, where they end up encountering mischievous and highly dangerous spirits.

Episodes.Title: Kagayake! Kintaro
Episodes.Description: Usagi and the turtles must help Kintaro fulfill his destiny as they reach the end of their journey.

Episodes.Title: Lone Rat and Cubs
Episodes.Description: When Splinter is first mutated, he must learn to survive the life of a mutant on the run while also protecting four baby mutant turtles.

Episodes.Title: Raphael Mutant Apocalypse, Part 1: The Wasteland Warrior
Episodes.Description: An older and weathered Raphael battles road gangs in a post-apocalyptic mutant wasteland.

Episodes.Title: Raphael Mutant Apocalypse, Part 2: The Impossible Desert
Episodes.Description: An older and weathered Raphael battles road gangs in a post-apocalyptic mutant wasteland.

Episodes.Title: Raphael Mutant Apocalypse, Part 3: Carmageddon
Episodes.Description: An older, weathered Raphael battles road gangs in a post-apocalyptic mutant wasteland.

Episodes.Title: The Curse of Savanti Romero
Episodes.Description: The Turtles' plans to enjoy Halloween are put on hold when strange monsters threaten to transform New York City.

Episodes.Title: The Crypt of Dracula
Episodes.Description: Renet transports the Turtles to 13th century Transylvania to stop Savanti Romero.

Episodes.Title: The Frankenstein Experiment
Episodes.Description: Savanti is soon to recruit Frankenstein's Monster and unleash all of his monstrous recruits on the 21st Century.

Episodes.Title: Monsters Among Us
Episodes.Description: When the Turtles and Renet return to a present-day New York City infested by an undead army of monsters, they realize they may have made the situation even worse.

Episodes.Title: Wanted: Bebop & Rocksteady
Episodes.Description: When 80s Shredder and Krang appear in the 2012 dimension, they employ Bebop and Rocksteady and find their plans are succeeding better than ever. Meanwhile, the Turtles try to adjust to life without serious bad guys.

Episodes.Title: The Foot Walks Again!
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must train their 80s counterparts into fighting like real ninja. The 80s Turtles begin to learn the difference between their world and the world of their modern counterparts.

Episodes.Title: The Big Blow Out
Episodes.Description: The Turtles, their 1987 counterparts, April and the Mighty Mutanimals must work together to stop 80s' Shredder and Krang from destroying the world. Meanwhile, Bebop and Rocksteady are faced with a difficult and life-changing decision.

Episodes.Title: The Turtles and the Hare
Episodes.Description: In Krang's latest scheme, Rocksteady and Bebop, dressed as Easter bunnies, are blasting people with a Docilizer Ray and turning them into timid, rabbit-like people.

Episodes.Title: Once Upon a Time Machine
Episodes.Description: Hokum Hare discovers that Shredder has a time train to travel to the future, where he can become crimelord of a crime-free era.

Episodes.Title: My Brother, the Bad Guy
Episodes.Description: Shredder breaks into the Ninja Hall of Fame and steals the diary of the famous Brothers Kojima. He leaves his fingerprints all over the place though, and one Lieutenant Saki, Shredder's brother, finds them.

Episodes.Title: Michaelangelo Meets Mondo Gecko
Episodes.Description: Michaelangelo awakes in the middle of the night from a bad dream. Unable to remember what it was about, Splinter assists him through hypnotism. Mikey vividly recalls the day that he and his brothers fell into the sewer and landed in the green ooze but he also sees a small lizard crawling through the contaminant.

Episodes.Title: Enter: Mutagen Man
Episodes.Description: In the frozen tundra of the Arctic Polar Cap, Krang rants and raves that Rocksteady and Bebop will not return in time with the Bindex 3 to load the mutagen into the rocket ship's fuel tanks before lift off. Krang' plans turn all the City's inhabitants into horribly disfigured mutants from the vapor trails of the fuel used to lift the rocket.

Episodes.Title: Donatello's Badd Time
Episodes.Description: While road testing the Turtle Van with his latest inventions, Donatello encounters a family of criminal hillbillies known as the Badd Family.

Episodes.Title: Muckman Messes Up
Episodes.Description: Attempting to de-mutate the Turtles, Krang sends Shredder, Rocksteady and Bebop to the Earth's surface to retrieve Compound X-7.

Episodes.Title: Michaelangelo Meets Bugman Again
Episodes.Description: Michaelangelo and the other Turtles go topside in an effort to find the latest issue of "The Adventures of Bugman", only to learn that the comic book has been canceled.

Episodes.Title: Napoleon Bonafrog: Colossus of the Swamps
Episodes.Description: While Krang hires some local hoods to drill for anti-freeze Shredder, Rocksteady and Bebop visit the Louisiana Swamps in search of the Mutagen Pool.

Episodes.Title: Raphael VS The Volcano
Episodes.Description: Thanks to a malfunction in Donatello's Healthometer, an invention designed to diagnose one's health, Raphael is convinced that he is not long for this world. Raphael decides to make the world a better place with what little time he has left.

Episodes.Title: Landlord of the Flies
Episodes.Description: Baxter Fly is back, and this time he has assembled an army of flies to infest the city, endangering millions just so Stockman can get to Shredder.

Episodes.Title: Donatello's Duplicate
Episodes.Description: Donatello decides to create a clone of himself so that he can spend more time on his inventions while his clone spends more time fixing things around the Lair. Donny tests his latest invention on a sewer rat and accidentally gets his hand in the way, causing the rat clone to talk just like Donatello.

Episodes.Title: The Ice Creature Cometh
Episodes.Description: While the Turtles do battle with a refrigerator that has not been defrosted lately, Rocksteady and Bebop decide that they want to be the top mutants at the Technodrome and throw out a vat of mutagen onto the frozen tundra, creating a giant Ice Creature.

Episodes.Title: Leonardo Cuts Loose
Episodes.Description: A series of baffling crimes are being committed by "brawny burglars" with thick Austrian accents and the Turtles are on the case, but so is Casey Jones and that could mean nothing but trouble for the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Pirate Radio
Episodes.Description: Krang's attempt to split the Inter-Dimensional portal goes awry. By utilizing the pirate radio station WOOF Krang believes that he can use the station to lure the City's populace into Krang's Chasm.

Episodes.Title: Raphael, Turtle of a Thousand Faces
Episodes.Description: Raphael's ego is bruised when the other Turtles laugh at him for taking a correspondence class in the art of disguise. Raphael challenges his brothers to go to Central Park and pick him out of a crowd.

Episodes.Title: Zach and the Alien Invaders
Episodes.Description: Zach, the Turtles' young friend, and honorary fifth Turtle, is infatuated with comic books, especially 'The Alien Invaders.' Zach retires his Turtle costume when his parents enroll him in the Ten-Hut Military Academy where they hope he will learn some discipline and live in the real world.

Episodes.Title: Leonardo, the Renaissance Turtle
Episodes.Description: The City Mayor announces an end to crime when he introduces Professor Mindbender and the professor's latest invention: LEX, a robotic police officer. LEX rids the streets of crime enough to allow the Turtles to take a vacation.

Episodes.Title: Welcome Back, Polarisoids
Episodes.Description: Krang wants to get a hold of the Polarisoids' camera. Krang sends a fake invitation to the Polarisoids to visit Earth, only the Polarisoids think that the invitation is from the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Michaelangelo, the Sacred Turtle
Episodes.Description: While the other Turtles go off to the local Planetarium to see O'Malley's comet, Michaelangelo visits the Natural History Museum with April O'Neil for the unveiling of the mummy of Ahmed Turt-el.

Episodes.Title: Planet of the Turtleloids, Part 1
Episodes.Description: The turtles, Groundchuck and Dirtbag are taken to Shellri-La by an alien "Turtleoid" named Kerma. Kerma seeks help from the turtles to defend his planet from a two-headed dragon named Herman the Horrible.

Episodes.Title: Planet of the Turtleloids, Part 2
Episodes.Description: The turtles unmask the dragon as they prove that the menacing creature is actually operated by two renegade Turtleoid delegates. Kerma return the turtles back to Earth, where they destroy Shredder's new Technodrome Mark II and afterwards defeat Chrome Dome.

Episodes.Title: Lap of the Gods
Episodes.Description: The Ninja Tribunal has called on eight acolytes to stop the coming evil. But first they have to train and be taught some important lessons that may mean the difference between life and death.

Episodes.Title: Demons and Dragons
Episodes.Description: The Turtles begin training with the mysterious Ninja Tribunal, experimenting with new powers and weapons. After securing the first of the Tribunal’s Lost Artifacts, our heroes learn to their horror that the “great evil” they are destined to face is the long-imprisoned spirit of the one, true Shredder!

Episodes.Title: Legend of the 5 Dragons
Episodes.Description: The Turtles train with the Ninja Tribunal to prevent the resurrection of the Shredder. But when Splinter and the Ancient One express serious doubts about trusting the Tribunal, the Turtles are confused. If they all agree on the goal, why the doubts? To explain the danger to the Turtles, Splinter and the Ancient One reveal the secret history of the Tribunal… including the true origin of the Shredder!

Episodes.Title: More Worlds Than One
Episodes.Description: The Turtles and company continue their training under the Ninja Tribunal, learning to fight in the physical as well as mental and spiritual worlds. They’re going to need that knowledge, because the second artefact of the Shredder has been found, guarded by a horde of nasty Tengu demons that eat Acolytes for breakfast… literally!

Episodes.Title: Beginning of the End
Episodes.Description: Returning to the Tribunal Monastery with the second Shredder Artefact, things seem to be going well for our heroes when – deception! Old foes infiltrate the Monastery. With all three artefacts in the hands of evil, they plan a sneak attack on the Tribunal and their students with devastating results!

Episodes.Title: Membership Drive
Episodes.Description: The Justice Force is expanding its ranks, and Mikey plans on joining up as Turtle Titan!, while Leo is more concerned in alerting them to the threat of the original Shredder. But when Nano reappears (thanks to Bishop and Baxter Stockman), everything quickly spirals out of control into a super hero vs. nanotech slugfest! But has Nano come back as friend or foe? And will the Turtle Titan and Leo survive long enough to find out?

Episodes.Title: New World Order (1)
Episodes.Description: The original Shredder is resurrected by the Foot Mystics, whose first agenda is to destroy Karai – the “false Shredder.” And, while the Turtles are enemies of both Shredders, they realize that if the original Shredder wins, his goal of creating a world of destruction, devastation and chaos will be one huge step closer to reality. So, like it or not, they have to help Karai – even while she’s intent on killing them!

Episodes.Title: New World Order (2)
Episodes.Description: In their attempt to rescue Karai from the Foot Mystics and new Shredder, the Turtles wind up in a raging battle filled with magic and martial arts where they use everything the Tribunal taught them - but will it be enough to escape with Karai and their lives?

Episodes.Title: Fathers & Sons
Episodes.Description: Weary after their first battle with the new Shredder, the Turtles doubt they can defeat him. To lift their spirits, Splinter and the Ancient One shares a tale of the Turtles’ toddler days. The story reveals that though the Turtles were small, they overcame impossible odds to defeat a phantom bent on reviving the Shredder, though they may not remember it.

Episodes.Title: Past and Present
Episodes.Description: Shredder begins to build a new dynasty in New York, transforming the whole island into a hellish nightmare.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Dragons (1)
Episodes.Description: The demonic Shredder has transformed New York City into a nightmare version of Feudal Japan and the rest of the modern world is next! But the Turtles have a plan, and if it takes allying themselves with some of their former enemies to bring the fight to the Shredder, so be it... because if they fail, all life as they known it will cease to exist.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Dragons (2)
Episodes.Description: With the help of their closest allies and most dangerous enemies alike, the Turtles have fought their way through a demonic version of New York to confront the Shredder once and for all! Now the Turtles must have everything they've got and have no choice but to focus their energy and become their very own mystic avatars...Dragons. This night, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles will meet their destinies: Whether to live or die!

Episodes.Title: Rock Around the Block
Episodes.Description: Krang summons General Tragg from the Dimension X to keep the Turtles busy while Shredder places a remote control transmitter upon a rocket ship preparing to launch a satellite with a new super laser.

Episodes.Title: Krangenstein Lives!
Episodes.Description: Under the Arctic Ocean Krang is tuning up his Robotic Body. While no one is looking, Bebop and Rocksteady inadvertently destroy an important computer chip and surreptitiously replace it with one from a video game.

Episodes.Title: Super Irma
Episodes.Description: While the Turtles are busy trying to decide what costumes to wear to this year's Channel Six Halloween party, April and Irma are doing a story on the reverse polarity magnet at Magno-Dyne Labs.

Episodes.Title: Adventures in Turtle-Sitting
Episodes.Description: While Splinter is away on meditative satori, Donatello sets his sights on solving world hunger. He invents the food revivafiver, a device designed to reverse the aging process of food.

Episodes.Title: Sword of Yurikawa
Episodes.Description: Krang plans to blow up the Tri-State Bridge just as a convoy of trucks carrying a rare form of toxic waste passes overhead.

Episodes.Title: Return of the Turtleoids
Episodes.Description: The Turtles go to the Top Notch Scientific Corporation to stand guard over the sonic disintegrator.

Episodes.Title: Shreeka's Revenge
Episodes.Description: Shreeka, an alien with an attitude and a vendetta against Krang, after having spent eons tracking him down, has finally found him.

Episodes.Title: Too Hot to Handle
Episodes.Description: Donatello tells the other three Turtles that, based on his calculations, the Earth has changed its orbit and is heading for the Sun.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare in the Lair
Episodes.Description: Donatello's newest invention, the Dream-o-Vision helmet, causes Michaelangelo and Leonardo to be stuck in a nightmare world.

Episodes.Title: Phantom of the Sewers
Episodes.Description: After another night's performance of the robotic Willie Wombat Revue at the Willie Wombat Revue Theatre, a mysterious figure, wearing a long black cape, black fedora, white face mask, and known only as the Phantom, makes an appearance.

Episodes.Title: Donatello Trashes Slash
Episodes.Description: Donatello goes to Channel Six News to give Vernon a piece of his mind after he had made disparaging comments about Turtles on live TV.

Episodes.Title: Leonardo Is Missing
Episodes.Description: When Donatello, Michaelangelo, and Raphael return from the video arcade they discover that Donatello's lab is in disarray and Leonardo is missing.

Episodes.Title: Snakes Alive!
Episodes.Description: While practicing their martial arts, Leonardo tells Splinter that he is convinced that there is one combat maneuver he has yet to teach the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Polly Wanna Pizza
Episodes.Description: Michaelangelo returns from his sojourn to the pet shop with a monkey named Clyde. After only a few minutes with the undisciplined pet Leonardo, Donatello and Raphael demand that it be returned to the pet shop.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Nice Guy
Episodes.Description: Burne assigns April a story reporting on the increase in urban crime. The only problem is that urban crime is decreasing.

Episodes.Title: Sleuth on the Loose
Episodes.Description: While the Turtles are watching their favorite TV show April interrupts the broadcast with a special bulletin about a break-in at Dynamic Science Labs.

Episodes.Title: Future Shellshock
Episodes.Description: The Turtles and Splinter find themselves in a futuristic world after accidentally being pulled through a time window.

Episodes.Title: Obsolete
Episodes.Description: The Turtles use new technology to create new weapons in an effort to escape the future.

Episodes.Title: Home Invasion
Episodes.Description: A computer virus traps the Turtles inside the Dojo and they must fight for their lives.

Episodes.Title: Headlock Prime
Episodes.Description: Raph competes in a professional wrestling tournament, which is interrupted by a banned wrestler looking to prove himself.

Episodes.Title: Playtime's Over
Episodes.Description: Mikey is excited when a video game sequel is released; the Turtles need a guide to navigate the mall.

Episodes.Title: Bishop to Knight
Episodes.Description: The Turtles find out that Agent Bishop is alive in the year 2105.

Episodes.Title: Night of Sh'okanabo!
Episodes.Description: Mikey brings Cody and his three friends to a horror film festival, where they meet Sh'okanabo face to face.

Episodes.Title: Clash of the Turtle Titans
Episodes.Description: Mikey discovers that someone has taken his old superhero persona, Turtle Titan.

Episodes.Title: Fly Me to the Moon
Episodes.Description: Cody and the Turtles search for a rare alloy on the moon; Inuwashi Gunjin goes there to make sure they do not return alive.

Episodes.Title: Invasion of the Body Snatcher!
Episodes.Description: Jammerhead uses the Bodyjacker to take over Darius Dun's body to steal O'Neil Tech's secrets.

Episodes.Title: The Freaks Come Out At Night
Episodes.Description: Sh'Okanabo implants gene seeds in Mikey, beginning his first test of introducing the seeds into the general population.

Episodes.Title: Bad Blood
Episodes.Description: The Turtles' psychotic clones try to prove that they are bigger, badder and better than the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: The Journal
Episodes.Description: The Turtles come across April and Casey's old future-history journal.

Episodes.Title: The Gaminator
Episodes.Description: Viral sets a trap that digitizes and sucks the Turtles into a prototype game system, the Gaminator.

Episodes.Title: Graduation Day - Class of 2105.
Episodes.Description: Splinter announces that the Turtles will graduate to the next ninja rank, except Michelangelo.

Episodes.Title: Timing Is Everything
Episodes.Description: Sh'Okanabo unleashes a time storm on New York, putting the Turtles in the middle of chaos.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Jammerhead
Episodes.Description: Jammerhead escapes from prison and confronts the Turtles during a visit from Starlee's alien family.

Episodes.Title: Milk Run
Episodes.Description: An intergalactic mercenary enlists the Turtles' help in smuggling a ship full of humanitarian aid past Triceraton gangsters.

Episodes.Title: The Fall of Darius Dunn
Episodes.Description: When Cody uncovers a secret weapons-manufacturing program, he and his uncle have a showdown over who will ultimately control the O'Neilltech empire.

Episodes.Title: Turtle X-Tinction
Episodes.Description: Darius Dunn controls Turtle X to exact revenge on his nephew and the Turtles.

Episodes.Title: Race for Glory
Episodes.Description: Triple Threat crashes a cross-country road race and steals all the cars.

Episodes.Title: Head of State
Episodes.Description: The Turtles must rescue the president before he loses his head to a sinister figure from their past.

Episodes.Title: DNA Is Thicker Than Water
Episodes.Description: Dark Leo tries to prove himself by destroying the Turtles from within.

Episodes.Title: The Cosmic Completist
Episodes.Description: The leader of Inawashi Gunjin asks the turtles for help with a malicious alien.

Episodes.Title: The Day of Awakening
Episodes.Description: When the entire population of Moonbase Bishop goes missing and the Turtles stage an assault on the base, they find a bigger Sh'Okanabo with an army of drones.

Episodes.Title: Zixxth Sense
Episodes.Description: Torbin Zixx persuades the turtles to help him recover an experimental matter transmitter.

Episodes.Title: Tower of Power
Episodes.Description: The Turtles and Splinter win a trip to Europe, but wind up riding in a crate with the Turtle Van. Meanwhile, Krang devises a giant electromagnet to pull the Technodrome free from an asteroid.

Episodes.Title: Rust Never Sleeps
Episodes.Description: Krang works on an oxidizer rocket with enough power to blast the Technodrome to Earth, but something goes wrong, and instead of thrust, the device grows rust.

Episodes.Title: A Real Snow Job
Episodes.Description: The Turtles are vacationing in the Alps, as Splinter goes off to a nearby mountain to meditate. April is in an Alpine village with Irma when she notices the ice and snow melting, unusual for this time of year.

Episodes.Title: Venice on a Half Shell
Episodes.Description: Krang decides to use a hydrofluxer device to flood Venice, holding it for ransom.

Episodes.Title: Artless
Episodes.Description: Two snobbish art-collecting aliens arrive in Florence and begin stealing great works of art.

Episodes.Title: Ring of Fire
Episodes.Description: Krang sends Shredder to set up a special lens that will focus the sun's rays to create a devastating heat ray.

Episodes.Title: The Irish Jig Is Up
Episodes.Description: Krang and Shredder decide to use Ireland as their base for the Technodrome. With a device called the Rainbow Trans-Charmer, the villains intend to turn harmless little creatures like sheep and rabbits into slavering beasts.

Episodes.Title: Shredder's New Sword
Episodes.Description: In Dimension X Krang is using a long-range scanner and discovers a rare metal buried in a ruined castle in England. The metal turns out to be King Arthur's legendary sword, Excalibur.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Queen of Atlantis
Episodes.Description: Shredder, Rocksteady and Bebop are searching for a valuable energy source in Athens and discover that it is April's new necklace.

Episodes.Title: Turtles on the Orient Express
Episodes.Description: April is covering the revival of the Orient Express. Shredder is on the train with Rocksteady and Bebop carrying the supercharger, a device to accelerate the train to super speed.

Episodes.Title: April Gets in Dutch
Episodes.Description: April is covering the showing of the world-famed Duchess Diamond. Krang wants the diamond, a flawless stone, to focus the rays on his laser dimension blade.

Episodes.Title: Northern Lights Out
Episodes.Description: Eric Red, seizes both April and Professor Swenson's map to the underground volcanoes in Scandinavia to tap into the molten energy and melt the polar ice caps.

Episodes.Title: Elementary, My Dear Turtle
Episodes.Description: The Turtles are in England, when they are taken back to the past, via an experimental atomic clock and must team up with Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson in order to get the clock back and return to the present.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Dark Turtle
Episodes.Description: Donatello's Early Detection system sounds its alarm. According to Donatello's readings, the city has experienced a major vibration emanating from the Earth.

Episodes.Title: The Starchild
Episodes.Description: While rummaging through the local junkyard the Turtles witness the crash landing of an alien spacecraft.

Episodes.Title: The Legend of Koji
Episodes.Description: At the Museum of Fine Art Shredder uses his time portal to journey back to ancient Japan so that he can destroy Splinter and the turtles.

Episodes.Title: Convicts from Dimension X
Episodes.Description: Thanks to a malfunction in Donatello's Inter-Dimensional Early Warning Detection Machine, a tear has occurred in the fabric of space and time, allowing two heinous criminals from Dimension X, Skaarg and Dementor, to arrive in the city.

Episodes.Title: White Belt, Black Heart
Episodes.Description: Splinter is contacted telepathically by his sensei, Master Mogo-san who requests that Splinter meet him at Pier 17.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Rogues
Episodes.Description: Krang, Shredder, Bebop and Rocksteady break in to the City Hall Records Department and steal maps of the sewer system dated 1895.

Episodes.Title: Attack of the Neutrinos
Episodes.Description: While investigating the most recent robbery perpetrated by the Mole Squad, April and the Turtles stumble upon a secret meeting between the Mole Squad and Dr. Floyd O'Toole, a scientist who has been missing for weeks.

Episodes.Title: Escape from the Planet of the Turtleloids
Episodes.Description: The Turtles visit April at Channel Six News and ask her if they could use the stations' equipment to contact their old Turtleoid buddy, Kerma, on Shell-Ri-La.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of the Fly
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Vernon's irresponsible journalism, the Turtles find it necessary to stand guard at the Genetic Research Lab.

Episodes.Title: Atlantis Awakes
Episodes.Description: While surfing in the white water rapids of the sewer, Michaelangelo is rescued by Merdude. Tthe Turtles, using Donatello's Porta-Tracker, volunteer to help Merdude find his way back home.

Episodes.Title: Dirk Savage: Mutant Hunter
Episodes.Description: After an unsuccessful attempt at capturing Razar and Toka, the Turtles return to the lair to see the eccentric billionaire, A. J. Howard, spouting his ideology and his hatred for mutants across the airwaves.

Episodes.Title: Invasion of the Krangezoids
Episodes.Description: Krang makes copies of himself and sets them loose to attack the turtles.

Episodes.Title: Combat Land
Episodes.Description: There is a new amusement park in town and called Combat Land. The park's owner, Horatio Stressbar, has been unable to find anyone with the combat skills to give his robotic warriors a thorough work out.

Episodes.Title: Shredder Triumphant
Episodes.Description: Shredder, Rocksteady, and Bebop arrive at the Asian arts exhibit and proceed to loot. The turtles head out to stop them despite a grave warning from Splinter that there will be dire consequences.

Episodes.Title: Tempus Fugit
Episodes.Description: When the Time Window is repaired, the Turtles enter it to go home, but instead of ending up back at the lair they are sent on a harrowing trip through the past, present and future.

Episodes.Title: Karate Schooled
Episodes.Description: The Turtles are reunited with Casey and April; Casey is brainwashed by his new martial arts instructor.

Episodes.Title: Something Wicked
Episodes.Description: The Turtles journey into cyberspace as Cybernauts on a mission to save as much of Master Splinter as they can find.

Episodes.Title: The Engagement Ring
Episodes.Description: The engagement ring Casey and Raph pick out for April has powers that Hun and the Purple Dragons want.

Episodes.Title: Hacking Stockman
Episodes.Description: While Don collects Splinter's data bits, his brothers are pulled into a war between the Foot and the Purple Dragons.

Episodes.Title: The Incredible Shrinking Serling
Episodes.Description: Serling, desperate to return to his own time, builds a makeshift Time Window.

Episodes.Title: Identity Crisis
Episodes.Description: Cyber Shredder releases a virus that wipes out the turtles' memories.

Episodes.Title: Web Wranglers
Episodes.Description: The Cyber Shredder creates a web portal that will allow him to travel from cyberspace into the real world.

Episodes.Title: Superquest
Episodes.Description: The Turtles find more of Splinter's lost data bits, but they are embedded in the interface of Mikey's favorite online video game, SuperQuest.

Episodes.Title: Virtual Reality Check
Episodes.Description: Shredder makes the turtles believe they have left cyberspace, when they are really still there giving him important information about how to build a portal.

Episodes.Title: City Under Siege
Episodes.Description: The Shredder hacks into a computer grid and reprograms every electronic device in New York.

Episodes.Title: Super Power Struggle
Episodes.Description: The Justice Force asks Raph to join their ranks after he gets a cape that gives him super powers.

Episodes.Title: Wedding Bells and Bytes
Episodes.Description: The Turtles and Master Splinter get ready for April and Casey's wedding.

Episodes.Title: Get Shredder!
Episodes.Description: Shredder & Krang are still loose on Earth, but without the resources of the Technodrome, they plan to steal equipment from the abandoned Hall of Science at the World Fair. Krang's former weapons engineer, Drakus, using the guise of Beserko, also shows up to cause trouble.

Episodes.Title: Wrath of the Rat King
Episodes.Description: Burne has created a hot line for callers to use should they spot those responsible for the destruction of the Channel Six News Building. Inside the Hall of Science, Shredder is fearful that the Turtles will eventually find a way into the building and decides to seek out an old friend in the sewers: the Rat King!

Episodes.Title: State of Shock
Episodes.Description: After defeating a mysterious group of ninjas at the Emeryville Power Station, the Turtles decode part of a map that they were able to liberate from the would-be thieves.

Episodes.Title: Cry H.A.V.O.C.!
Episodes.Description: The Turtles get the drop on masked thieves hijacking a jewellery store, only to have themselves arrested for the crime! Before the turtles can be booked, they are rescued by the mutants Amok and Overdrive.

Episodes.Title: H.A.V.O.C. in the Streets
Episodes.Description: Titanus sends of couple of his H.A.V.O.C. mutants to bust into the aerospace plant and steal some much needed equipment. Only problem is that the Turtles were waiting for them.

Episodes.Title: Enter: Krakus
Episodes.Description: Krakus, a cop from the future, arrives and thinking that the Turtles are in league with Titanus, shakes them down for information.

Episodes.Title: Cyber-Turtles
Episodes.Description: While investigating the theft of a rare telescope, the Astro-Viewer, the Turtles discover odd tracks leading away from the National Space Exploration Center.

Episodes.Title: Turtle Trek
Episodes.Description: Krang activates his new dimensional portal, thanks to Shredder's installation of the Energy Transmitter at the Power Relay Station, giving him access to Dimension X.

Episodes.Title: The Unknown Ninja
Episodes.Description: While watching video tapes of old battles, Raphael sees a mystery person spying on them. While the Turtles investigate, an alien warlord named Dregg sends his TechnoGansters to steal all the gold on Earth.

Episodes.Title: Dregg of the Earth
Episodes.Description: April contacts the Turtles to let them know that Dregg has landed on Earth and is preparing a press conference. The Turtles rush to meet April at the Park, where they hear Dregg announce his friendly intentions and offers the world his molecular converter.

Episodes.Title: The Wrath of Medusa
Episodes.Description: Believing that the Turtles are the only thing that stands between him and total domination of the planet Dregg makes contact with Medusa, a sinisterly beautiful alien.

Episodes.Title: The New Mutation
Episodes.Description: After challenging Dregg to a final showdown, the Turtles find themselves on the losing end. Only this time, their new mutations have been captured on film and the world believes the Super Turtles to be evil monsters.

Episodes.Title: The Showdown
Episodes.Description: April contacts the Turtles to inform them that all the TV stations in the City are jammed. Sleazebug tries to recruit the Turtles for a martial arts tournament.

Episodes.Title: Split-Second
Episodes.Description: Carter, April and the Turtles investigate a break-in at the Antique Timepiece Museum. Convinced that Dregg is responsible, the Turtles discover a clue on a wall display.

Episodes.Title: Carter the Enforcer
Episodes.Description: Splinter convinces the Turtles that it is their duty to fight evil, even when the whole world is against them. Carter and the Turtles team up with April to get the goods on Dregg.

Episodes.Title: Doomquest
